text: Mahimo isa ka man sa nagapulaw sa paglantaw sang mga videos online agud malingaw mo ang imo kaugalingon.
english: You may be one of those who stay up late watching videos online to entertain yourself.

text: Kun kaangay sini ang imo aktibidad, pilia ang videos nga may mga cute nga sapat bangud may mga pagtuon nga nagapamatuod nga makapaayo ini sa imo ikaayong lawas.
english: If this is your activity, choose videos with cute animals because there are studies that prove it can improve your health.

text: Suno sa pagtuon sa University of Leeds sa United Kingdom, in partnership sa Western Australia Tourism, ang paglantaw sang mga laragway kag video sang cute nga mga sapat sa sulod sang 30 minutos ang makaapekto sa blood pressure, heart rate kag anxiety sang isa ka tawo.
english: According to a study at the University of Leeds in the United Kingdom, in partnership with Western Australia Tourism, looking at pictures and videos of cute animals for 30 minutes can affect a person’s blood pressure, heart rate and anxiety.

text: Sa experiment ni Dr. Andrea Utley, associate professor sa University of Leeds, may mga baby animals siya nga ginpalantaw sa 19 niya ka subject nga ginalakipan sang 15 ka estudyante kag apat ka staff nga lunsay stressed bangud sang ulubrahon sa eskwelahan.
english: In the experiment of Dr. Andrea Utley, associate professor at the University of Leeds, had baby animals shown to 19 of her subjects, including 15 students and four staff who were all stressed by schoolwork.

text: Matapos ang 30 minutos, lunsay man nagnubo ang blood pressure, heart rate kag anxiety sang mga participants.
english: After 30 minutes, the participants' blood pressure, heart rate and anxiety all decreased.

text: Nangin ‘within ideal blood pressure’ ang dugo sang mga pumalasakop, samtang nagnubo naman sa 35% ang anxiety nila sang gintakos gamit ang State-Trait Anxiety Inventory, isa ka self-assessment method nga ginagamit sa clinical settings sa pag-diagnose sang anxiety.
english: The participants' blood pressure was 'within ideal', while their anxiety dropped by 35% when measured using the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory, a self-assessment method used in clinical settings to diagnose anxiety.

text: Ikaw, ka-Bombo, indi gid magpatama sa imo ginabatyag nga kasubo: gamita man sang husto ang imo tion online agud mabuhinan ang imo nga anxiety.
english: You, ka-Bombo, never give in to your feelings of sadness: also use your time online to reduce your anxiety.

text: Iga-review sang 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan ang security protocols lakip na ang Inter-agency coordination mechanisms para sa seguridad sang mga pasahero sa Iloilo International Airport kasunod sang nagluntad nga shooting incident sa sulod sang paluparan sang Enero 28, 2026.
english: The 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan will review the security protocols including the Inter-agency coordination mechanisms for the security of passengers at the Iloilo International Airport following the shooting incident inside the airport on January 28, 2026.

text: Santo sa ginpasar nga Resolution 2026-02-17, nagapanawagan ini sa Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP), Department of Transportation (DOTr), kag ang Philippine National Police Aviation Security Group (PNP-AVESGROUP) agud madiskusyonan ang nagakadapat nga tikang nga himuon sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: According to Resolution 2026-02-17, it calls on the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP), Department of Transportation (DOTr), and the Philippine National Police Aviation Security Group (PNP-AVESGROUP) to discuss the appropriate steps to be taken in the incident.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Vice Governor Nathalie Ann Debuque, Sponsor sang amo nga resolusyon, iya gin-athag nga ini ang gin-ubra nga lihok indi agud basulon ang kun sin-o man ang may sala, sa baylo ini agud tan-awon kun nasunod ang protocols kag matumod ang ‘weaknesses’ kag makahatag man sang rekomendasyon ang katapo sang provincial board.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Vice Governor Nathalie Ann Debuque, sponsor of the resolution, explained that this was not done to blame anyone who was guilty, but to see if the protocols were followed and identify weaknesses and recommendations.

text: Apisar nga yara sa idalom sang isa ka national government agency ang paluparan, suno sa Bise Gobernador nga kinamatarung sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan nga ipatuman ang legislative oversight bangud natabo ini sa sulod sang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Although the airport is under a national government agency, the Vice Governor said it is the right of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan to implement legislative oversight because it happened within the province of Iloilo.

text: Nangin positibo naman ang response sang mga ipatawag nga mga ahensya kag may patigayunon nga committee hearing sa bwas nga adlaw sang Huebes, Pebrero 5, 2026 nga ginpangunahan sang Committee on Transportation, Communication, and Public Utilities kun sa diin si Debuque man ang Chair, kaupod ang Committe on Public Order and Security sa pagpanguna ni 2nd Dsitrict Board Member June S. Mondejar.
english: The response of the agencies to be summoned was positive and a committee hearing will be held tomorrow, Thursday, February 5, 2026, chaired by the Committee on Transportation, Communication, and Public Utilities where Debuque is also the Chair, along with the Committee on Public Order and Security led by Junior Board Member D. S. Mondejar.

text: Nangin matunog liwat ang pangalan sang Filipino Olympian nga si Eumir Marcial indi bangud sa pagdaog sa boksing kundi bangud sa akusasyon sang iya asawa nga nagluib ini sa ila pag-asawahay kag nangin abusado.
english: Filipino Olympian Eumir Marcial has become famous again not because of his boxing victory but because of his wife's accusation that he cheated on their marriage and became abusive.

text: Sa ginpaguwa nga official statement ni Princess Marcial, ginsiling sini nga dal-on sini sa korte ang iya akusasyon kag ipasa man ang mga ebidensya sa ginaalegar nga “love affair” sang iya bana.
english: In an official statement, Princess Marcial said she will take her accusation to court and also submit evidence of her husband's alleged love affair.

text: Ginsaysay sini nga nadakpan mismo niya sa akto si Eumir kag iya ‘other woman’ nga nagahingalan kay Jessa Santos sa isa ka condominium sa Pasay City sang Oktubre 2024 ukon pagkatapos mismo sang Paris Olympics.
english: He said he caught Eumir and his other woman named Jessa Santos in the act in a condominium in Pasay City in October 2024 or right after the Paris Olympics.

text: Sang amo nga tion, si Eumir kag ang mistress ang na-detain gid sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw apang ginhilway ang boksidor sang nagpirma si Princess sang affidavit of desistance nga i-withdraw ang complaint sa paglaom nga makaayo pa ang ila pag-asawahay.
english: At the time, Eumir and the mistress were detained for five days but the boxer was released when Princess signed an affidavit of desistance to withdraw the complaint in the hope of repairing their marriage.

text: Apang suno sa asawa, apisar sang tyansa nga iya ginhatag, naglala ang sitwasyon bangud nagsaylo pa gid si Eumir kag iya mistress sa Zamboanga kag didto may ginpatindog nga balay gamit ang kuwarta nga sinuptan nanday Eumir kag Princess.
english: However, according to the wife, despite the chance she gave, the situation got worse because Eumir and his mistress moved to Zamboanga and there they built a house with the money that Eumir and Princess earned.

text: “Little did I know that what started as a small act quickly grew to a sickening love affair with his young mistress from his hometown in Zamboanga City.
english: “Little did I know that what started as a small act quickly grew to a sickening love affair with his young mistress from his hometown in Zamboanga City.

text: Currently, I’ve managed to maintain some correspondence with some of our mutual and trusted friends in Zamboanga City where they alluded that Eumir and his mistress have decided to live together.
english: Currently, I’ve managed to maintain some correspondence with some of our mutual and trusted friends in Zamboanga City where they alluded that Eumir and his mistress have decided to live together.

text: Apparently, he withdrew all our savings and used the money to construct a house for him and his mistress in Zamboanga.
english: Apparently, he withdrew all our savings and used the money to construct a house for him and his mistress in Zamboanga.

text: I also have friends who have personally seen them together,” kabahin sang statement.
english: I also have friends who have personally seen them together,” the statement read.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Princess nga may mga pamahog nga ginbuy-an si Eumir kaangay sang pahayag nga wala sang makuha si Princess pananglitan magseparar sila nga duha.
english: Princess also revealed that there were threats that Eumir was released such as the statement that Princess would get nothing if they separated.

text: “As some of you may also know, I have been Eumir’s brand manager for the longest time, sacrificing my career to help build his.
english: “As some of you may also know, I have been Eumir’s brand manager for the longest time, sacrificing my career to help build his.

text: With this, I have also received active threats from Eumir saying he will ensure that I can no longer step in America nor get anything from our separation,” suno pa sa iya Facebook post.
english: With this, I have also received active threats from Eumir saying he will ensure that I can no longer step in America nor get anything from our separation,” according to his Facebook post.

text: Dugang pa sang asawa, gin-utod na sini ang tanan nga sources sang komunikasyon sa tunga nila matapos ang trauma, manipulasyon, emotional stress, physical abuse, kag psychological torment nga iya ginsusprer.
english: The wife added that she had cut off all sources of communication between them after the trauma, manipulation, emotional stress, physical abuse, and psychological torment she suffered.

text: “Our marriage means a lot to me, because it has divine blessing guided by the knowledge that it is also the foundation of every family.
english: “Our marriage means a lot to me, because it has divine blessing guided by the knowledge that it is also the foundation of every family.

text: How Eumir disrespected his vows to God and to me by cheating on me and continuously deceiving me had hurt me in unimaginable ways.
english: How Eumir disrespected his vows to God and to me by cheating on me and continuously deceiving me had hurt me in unimaginable ways.

text: I don’t think I can ever survive the pain, but my hope is that by speaking up, and in a way help other women who may have been suffering in silence, would give me the strength to continue in fighting for what is right in front of God who stood as a witness to our marriage.
english: I don’t think I can ever survive the pain, but my hope is that by speaking up, and in a way helping other women who may have been suffering in silence, would give me the strength to continue in fighting for what is right in front of God who stood as a witness to our marriage.

text:
I’ll leave it up to God’s hands to see that true and righteous justice be served to Eumir and his mistress.”

Wala na gindetalye ni Princess ang iban pa nga natabo bangud ipasaka man ini nga reklamo sa korte, apang ginplastar niya nga ginsapubliko niya ang hitabo para sa iya safety amo man sang iya pamilya kag mga testigo batok sa Pinoy boxer.
english:
I’ll leave it up to God’s hands to see that true and righteous justice be served to Eumir and his mistress.”

Princess did not elaborate on the other incidents because she will also file a complaint in court, but she said she made the incident public for her safety as well as that of her family and witnesses against the Pinoy boxer.

text: Isa man si Princess ka former amateur boxing national champion, anak ni former Cagayan de Oro boxing trainer kag international referee Reynaldo Galarpe, kag siya man ang nagatindog nga brand manager ni Eumir.
english: Princess is also a former amateur boxing national champion, the daughter of former Cagayan de Oro boxing trainer and international referee Reynaldo Galarpe, and she is also Eumir's brand manager.

text: 2021 sang ginkasal sila nga duha nga amo man ang tuig kun san-o nadag-an ni Marcial ang bronze medal sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: The two got married in 2021, the same year Marcial won the bronze medal at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Antes sila nagpasakal, siyam ka tuig na sila nga magkarelasyon.
english: Before they got married, they had been in a relationship for nine years.

text: Sang nalutos si Eumir sa imbukada nga hampang sini sa men’s light heavyweight category sa Paris Games sang 2024, matandaan nga updanay pa sila ni Princess kag gindayaw pa ang ila relasyon bangud sa pagpaumpaw sang asawa samtang emosyonal ang boksidor.
english: When Eumir lost his opening match in the men's light heavyweight category at the Paris Games in 2024, he and Princess were still together and praised their relationship for comforting his wife while the boxer was emotional.

text: Nagsulod sa professional boxing si Eumir sang 2020 kag subong naga-uyat sang 5-0 win-loss record.
english: Eumir entered professional boxing in 2020 and currently holds a 5-0 win-loss record.

text: Nagapati ang human rights lawyer nga dako ang impact sa international community sang natalana nga pag-atubang ni former President Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: The human rights lawyer believes that the scheduled appearance of former President Rodrigo Duterte at the International Criminal Court (ICC) will have a huge impact on the international community.

text: Ini para sa confirmation hearing sang iya murder charges sa masunod nga bulan.
english: This is for the confirmation hearing of his murder charges next month.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gilbert Andres, iya ginpahayag nga ang kaso ni Duterte ang makapamatuod nga patas ang ICC kag wala lamang ini nagasentro sa isa ka kontinente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gilbert Andres, he said that Duterte's case will prove that the ICC is fair and does not focus on one continent.

text: Suno sa iya, ini bangud sa masami, sa mga pungsod sa Africa nagahalin ang ginapasakaan sang kaso sa ICC apang subong, naghalin sa Asya ang may yara sang kaso.
english: According to him, this is because usually, African countries come from the cases filed in the ICC but now, there are cases from Asia.

text: Pahayag niya, magapakita man ini nga wala sang ginapili ang ICC pag-abot sa isyu sang human rights kag rule of law.
english: He said this will also show that the ICC is impartial when it comes to human rights and rule of law issues.

text: Si Andres ang isa sa common legal representatives nga para sa tanan nga biktima sang drug war sa Pilipinas sa kaso ni Duterte sa ICC.
english: Andres is one of the common legal representatives for all victims of the drug war in the Philippines in Duterte's case at the ICC.

text: Siya man ang executive director sang CenterLaw Philippines.
english: He is also the executive director of CenterLaw Philippines.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas kay Andres, gin-designate man si Atty. Joel Butuyan bilang abogado sang drug war victims.
english: Besides Andres, Atty. Joel Butuyan as a lawyer for drug war victims.

text: Ang duha ang napilian bangud man sa ila eligibility nga wala sang record sang “inappropriate conduct” kag wala man sang conflict of interest sa kaso case.
english: The two were selected based on their eligibility, no record of inappropriate conduct and no conflict of interest in the case.

text: Ang confirmation of charges hearing batok kay Duterte natalana  sa Pebrero 23  kag magalawig tubtob Pebrero  27.
english: The confirmation of charges hearing against Duterte is scheduled for February 23 and will last until February 27.

text: INDIA – Nakahibalo ka bala nga ang tawo nga makahambal sang indi magnubo sa duha ka lenggwahe ang may dako nga posibilidad nga makabalik sa normal nga cognitive function pagkatapos ma stroke?
english: INDIA – Did you know that a person who speaks at least two languages ​​is more likely to regain normal cognitive function after a stroke?

text: Suno kay Dr. Suvarna Alladi, neurology professor sa Nizam’s Institute of Medical Sciences sa Hyderabad, India, ang paghibalo sang madamo nga lenggwahe ang naga-challenge sa utok kag ini ang naga-promote sa neuroplasticity ukon “cognitive reserve,”.
english: According to Dr. Suvarna Alladi, neurology professor at the Nizam’s Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad, India, knowing multiple languages ​​challenges the brain and this promotes neuroplasticity or “cognitive reserve,”.

text: Ang cognitive reserve amo ang nagabulig sa utok nga makapreparar sa bag-o nga mga pagtilaw kaangay sang pag-angkon sang balati-an.
english: Cognitive reserve is what helps the brain prepare for new challenges like getting sick.

text: Gina-enganyo naman ang paghibalo sang second language agud maka-communicate sa mas madamo nga tawo kun sa diin bonus na lang diri ang neurological nga benipisyo sini.
english: Knowing a second language is encouraged to communicate with more people where the neurological benefits are a bonus.

text: GERMANY – Nakahibalo ka bala nga ang breastfeeding ang makapugong sang obesity ukon tuman nga katambukon sa mga bata?
english: GERMANY – Did you know that breastfeeding can prevent obesity in children?

text: Sunu kay Dr. Berthold V. Koletzko, presidente sang European Society of Paediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition kag professor sa pediatrics sa Ludwig Maximilians University sa Munich sa Germany, ang mga baby nga gina-breastfeed ang may gamay nga risgo nga mangin obese sa ila pagdaku.
english: According to Dr. Berthold V. Koletzko, president of the European Society of Pediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition and professor of pediatrics at Ludwig Maximilians University in Munich in Germany, babies who are breastfed have a small risk of becoming obese later in life.

text: Ginpahayag ni Koletzko nga ang breastfeeding ang may long term effect kun sa diin nagapahagan-hagan man ini sa protein supply intake sang lapsag.
english: Koletzko said that breastfeeding has a long term effect where it also reduces the protein supply intake of the baby.

text: Kun mahimu suno kay Koletzko, likawan ang pagpasuso sa lapsag sang gatas halin sa baka bangud nga ini ang naga-contain sang protein nga mas mataas sang tatlo ka pilo kun ipaanggid sa human milk.
english: If possible, Koletzko said, avoid breastfeeding your baby with cow's milk because it contains three times more protein than human milk.

text: Ang protein suno sa natungdan ang isa man sa mga rason sang obesity.
english: Protein, he said, is also one of the causes of obesity.

text: Nagmandu na si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sang gilayon nga pag-umpisa sang negosasyon agud nga mahilway ang mga nabilin nga bihag sa Gaza kag matapos na ang gyera.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered the immediate start of negotiations to free the remaining hostages in Gaza and end the war.

text: Ginklaro sini nga ang mga kondisyon sa negosasyon ang dapat nga “acceptable” sa Israel.
english: He clarified that the terms in the negotiations must be “acceptable” to Israel.

text: Ini apisar nga gin-aprubahan man niya ang plano sang militar nga okuparon ang syudad sang Gaza.
english: This is despite the fact that he also approved the military's plan to occupy Gaza City.

text: “I came to approve the army’s plans to take control of Gaza City and decide the battle against Hamas,” suno sa prime minister.
english: “I came to approve the army’s plans to take control of Gaza City and decide the battle against Hamas,” the prime minister said.

text:
“At the same time, I instructed immediate negotiations for the release of all our hostages and to end the war under conditions acceptable to Israel.”

Base sa militar, 50 pa ka mga bihag ang yara sa kamot sang Hamas militants apang 20 na lang ang ginapatihan nga buhi pa.
english:

text: Naga-akusar naman ang mga rights groups nga may ginahimo pa nga torture kag medical neglect.#
english: Rights groups accuse torture and medical neglect.

text: NAGABUG-AT na gid ang problema sa pag-park sang mga salakyan diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: THE problem of parking vehicles in Iloilo City is getting worse.

text: Tungod ina sa madasig man nga pagdugang sang pagpanag-iya sang mga salakyan diri, kag sang pagsulod sang iban pa halin sa gwa.
english: That's due to the rapid increase in car ownership here, and the influx of others from outside.

text: Sa problema sang kakulang sang parkingan diri sa siyudad, may hingyu na gani ang gobyerno sa pagtukod sang multi-level nga parking space sa pila ka palapag paibabaw sa isa ka building sa tupad mismo sang Iloilo City Hall.
english: With the problem of lack of parking in the city, the government has even requested to build a multi-level parking space on several floors above a building next to the Iloilo City Hall.

text: Ang PSTMO gahingyu gani nga untaton na gid lang sing lubos ang on-road parking!
english: The PSTMO is even asking for a complete ban on on-road parking!

text: Ugaling lang, diin ta abe sayluhon ining mga salakyan nga indi gid man malayo sa ila pagka-kinahanglan?
english: However, where do we move these vehicles that are not far from their need?

text: “Sa langit?
english: “In heaven?

text: Huwag naman ang ganyang biru!” siling gani sang amigo ko.
english: Don't be like that!” my friend said.

text: Kon ang problema amo ang kakulang sang parkingan, ang solusyon, syempre, amo ang pagdugang sang parkingan.
english: If the problem is a lack of parking, the solution, of course, is to increase parking.

text: Isa ka suhestyon amo ang pagtukod sang isa ka commercial parking facility nga mabuligan tukod sang gobyerno kag sang private sector paagi sa isa ka joint venture (JV), ukon Public-Private Partnership.
english: One suggestion is to build a commercial parking facility that will be helped by the government and the private sector through a joint venture (JV), or Public-Private Partnership.

text: Sa sining PPP, ipagamit sang gobyerno ang isa ka bakante nga duta agud patindugan sang negosyante sang iya parking business.
english: In this PPP, the government will use a vacant land for the entrepreneur to build his parking business.

text:
Ining joint venture gin-athag sang NEDA sa “Revised
Guidelines and Procedures for entering into Joint Venture (JV) Agreements
Between Government and Private Entities” nga gin-aprubahan sini sadtong Mayo 3,
2013.
english:
This joint venture is explained by NEDA in the “Revised
Guidelines and Procedures for entering into Joint Venture (JV) Agreements
Between Government and Private Entities” which it approved on May 3,
2013.

text:
Ang Revised Guidelines nagasiling sa 2.0
Principles:

“The Government shall enter into a JV arrangement
consistent with the following principles:

“2.1 The creation of the JV should not prevent
potential players from profitably entering into business venture/market;

“2.2 The cost of producing the particular product,
activity, or service should be efficient or potentially efficient towards
earning potential profits for government and the market player/private sector
partner;

“2.3 The role of government as regulator of the
business of the JV should be clearly and explicitly delineated from its role as
implementer of the business to avoid conflict of interest.”

Sa aton pa (sa Principle 2.1), ang gobyerno pwede makasulod sa profit-sharing upod sa private sector sa isa ka PPP nga project.
english:
The Revised Guidelines state in 2.0
Principles:

“The Government shall enter into a JV arrangement
consistent with the following principles:

“2.1 The creation of the JV should not prevent
potential players from profitably entering into business venture/market;

“2.2 The cost of producing the particular product,
activity, or service should be efficient or potentially efficient towards
earning potential profits for government and the market player/private sector
partner;

“2.3 The role of government as regulator of the
business of the JV should be clearly and explicitly delineated from its role as
implementer of the business to avoid conflict of interest.”

In other words (in Principle 2.1), the government can enter into profit-sharing with the private sector in a PPP project.

text: Ang rason diri (Principle 2.3) basta ang rolyo sang gobyerno amo lang bilang “regulator of the business” kag indi tagpalakat sang negosyo agud likawan ang “conflict of interest”.
english: The reason here (Principle 2.3) is that the role of the government is only as a regulator of the business and not as a business operator to avoid conflict of interest.

text: Ining “conflict of interest” nagatumod seguro sa isyu sang legalidad sang paggamit sa negosyo sang propiedad sang gobyerno.
english: This “conflict of interest” probably refers to the issue of the legality of the commercial use of government property.

text: In fact, amo-amo man gani ini ang rason sang pagpatuman sa Estados Unidos sang on-road parking fee agud makalikis sa legal nga isyu sa paggamit sang public roads agud makakuha sing parking fee.
english: In fact, this is the reason why the United States implemented an on-road parking fee to avoid the legal issue of using public roads to collect parking fees.

text: May isa na gani kita ka kaso sa diin nakasulod ang gobyerno sa isa ka PPP project.
english: We even have one case where the government got into a PPP project.

text: Ang ginatumod ta diri amo ang P125-M nga Parola Terminal nga joint venture sang siyudad kag sang Injap Corp.
english: We are referring to the P125-M Parola Terminal, a joint venture of the city and Injap Corp.

text: Maga-earn diri ang siyudad sing isa ka porsyento (1%) sa kita sang negosyo luas sa kitaon halin sa buhis.
english: The city will earn one percent (1%) of the business's revenue in addition to tax revenue.

text: 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗔𝗣𝗔𝗡 — Patay ang isa ka Southeast Asian (SEA) Games gold medalist matapos ginbuno sa dughan samtang nagakatulog sa Calapan City, Oriental Mindoro.
english: 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗔𝗣𝗔𝗡 — A Southeast Asian (SEA) Games gold medalist was killed after being stabbed in the chest while sleeping in Calapan City, Oriental Mindoro.

text: Ang biktima amo si Mervin Maligo Guarte, 33, miyembro sang Philippine Air Force kag naka-assign sa Fernando Airbase sa Lipa City.
english: The victim was identified as Mervin Maligo Guarte, 33, a member of the Philippine Air Force and assigned to Fernando Airbase in Lipa City.

text: Gindala pa si Guarte sa ospital, apang wala natabangan.
english: Guarte was rushed to the hospital, but was not helped.

text: Natabo ang krimen sa balay sang abyan sang biktima nga si Barangay Kagawad Dante Abel sa Sitio Pinagkaisahan sa Barangay Camilmil, Calapan City, las 4:30 kaina sang kaagahon.
english: The crime occurred at the house of the victim's friend, Barangay Kagawad Dante Abel in Sitio Pinagkaisahan in Barangay Camilmil, Calapan City, at 4:30 this morning.

text: Suno kay Police LtCol.
english: According to Police LtCol.

text: Roden Fulache, hepe sang Calapan City police, nagakatulog si Guarte sa sala sang balay ni Abel sang ginbuno sang wala pa makilal-an nga suspek.
english: Roden Fulache, chief of Calapan City police, said Guarte was sleeping in the living room of Abel's house when he was stabbed by an unidentified suspect.

text: Nakapangayo pa sang bulig ang biktima sa mga kasilingan nga nagdala sa iya sa Sta.
english: The victim sought help from neighbors who took him to Sta.

text: Maria Village Hospital antes ginsaylo sa Mindoro Medical Center sa diin siya gindeklarar nga patay.
english: Maria Village Hospital before being transferred to the Mindoro Medical Center where he was declared dead.

text: Nagwa sa imbestigasyon nga nagbisita lang ang biktima sa lugar kag nag-inom inom kagab-i tubtob las 3:00 kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Investigation revealed that the victim was just visiting the place and drinking last night until 3:00 this morning.

text: Narekober sang mga imbestigador sa ginluntaran sang krimen ang kutsilyo nga ginamit sa pagpatay kay Guarte.
english: Investigators recovered from the crime scene the knife used to kill Guarte.

text: Ginpakamalaot naman ni Oriental Mindoro Governor Humerlito “Bonz” Dolor ang pagpatay kay Guarte kadungan sang panawagan sang hustisya.
english: Oriental Mindoro Governor Humerlito “Bonz” Dolor condemned the killing of Guarte while calling for justice.

text: “Hindi matitinag ang aming panawagan para sa katarungan at patuloy naming hinahangad na mapanagot ang mga responsible sa krimeng ito,” sabi ni Dolor sa isang Facebook post.
english: “Our call for justice is unwavering and we continue to demand that those responsible for this crime be held accountable,” Dolor said in a Facebook post.

text: Ginmanduan man ni Governor Dolor si Oriental Mindoro Provincial Police Office Director Police Col.
english: Governor Dolor also ordered Oriental Mindoro Provincial Police Office Director Police Col.

text: Edison Revita nga solbaron ang krimen.
english: Edison Revita to solve the crime.

text: Si Guarte ang gold medalist sang 2023 SEA Games para sa men’s team relay, 2019 SEA Games gold medalist para sa men’s 5km, 2011 SEA Games silver medalist para sa men’s 800m and 1500 m kag 2024 Spartan Asia Pacific Champion sa men’s beast 21 km.
english: Guarte is the 2023 SEA Games gold medalist for the men’s team relay, 2019 SEA Games gold medalist for the men’s 5km, 2011 SEA Games silver medalist for the men’s 800m and 1500 m and the 2024 Spartan Asia Pacific Champion in the men’s 21 km beast.

text: Bata pa lang, nagpakita na sang iya tumalagsahon nga abilidad sa pagsaot ang Ilonggo Choreographer nga si Steven Jacosalemn sang Grand Slam Champion nga Tultugan Festival sa Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan 2026 kag sang Tribu Salognon nga amo naman ang nagkampeon sang Dinagyang 2026 Tribes Competition.
english: Even at a young age, Ilonggo Choreographer Steven Jacosalemn has already shown his extraordinary dancing skills in the Grand Slam Champion Tultugan Festival in Kasadyahan sa Babanwahan 2026 and the Tribu Salognon who also won the Dinagyang 2026 Tribes Competition.

text: Sa pagpakigbahin ni Steven Jacosalem sang iya istorya sa Bombo Radyo, iya ginpahayag nga halos wala sang tuig nga nagligad nga wala ini makabaton sang award sang bata pa ini bangud sang iya talento sa pagsaot.
english: Sharing his story with Bombo Radyo, Steven Jacosalem said that almost no year has passed since he received an award when he was a child because of his dancing talent.

text: Nagsugod si Jacosalem bilang isa ka bulilit dancer, kag nag-participate ini sa nagkalain-lain nga kompetisyon bilang isa ka performer.
english: Jacosalem started as a bulilit dancer, and she participated in various competitions as a performer.

text: Halin sa iya pagkabata, ginpabakod sini ang iya talento asta nga nakaangkon ini sang grand slam victory paagi sa Tribu Paghidaet sadto.
english: From his childhood, he strengthened his talent until he achieved a grand slam victory through Tribu Paghidaet.

text: Suno kay Jacosalem, bata pa lang ini ginapadala na ini sa iban nga mga lugar, kaangay sang Palawan, agud magtudlo sang pagsaot kag magpakigbahin sang iya nahibaluan sa iban.
english: According to Jacosalem, as a child, she was sent to other places, such as Palawan, to teach dancing and share her knowledge with others.

text: Dugang pa ni Jacosalem, indi mahapos ang iya una nga pagsugod sini sa iya karera apang bangud sang bulig sang mga tawo nga nagapati kag nagasuporta sa iya, nangin mas mahapos ang iya pag-atubang sang mga kabudlayan nga nag-abot sa iya kabuhi.
english: Jacosalem added that it was not easy for him to start his career but with the help of people who believed and supported him, it became easier for him to face the difficulties that came in his life.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga wala sang impossible sa isa ka tawo nga naga-focus sa ila mga handum bangud kun ang imo nga goal isa ka mataas dapat mo ini pangabudlayan kag tinguhaan nga maangkon.
english: He said that nothing is impossible for a person who focuses on their dreams because if your goal is high you have to work hard and try to achieve it.

text: Dako man ang iya pagpasalamat sa mga tawo nga nangin mentor sini bangud isa siya ka produkto sang ila maayo nga pagtudlo.
english: He is also very grateful to the people who have been his mentors because he is a product of their good teaching.

text: Ginsaysay man niya nga sang tion sang preparasyon para sa Dinagyang Festival 2026 tuman ang kabudlayan sini nga iya na-eksperyensyahan kag na-overwhelm gid ini kag maya ara pa sang tyempo nga kaangay nga nadulaan na ini sang kusog.
english: He also explained that during the preparation for the Dinagyang Festival 2026, he experienced a lot of difficulties and was overwhelmed and there were times when he felt like he had lost his strength.

text: Nagpadulong ini sa simbahan agud mangamuyo kag liwat nga gin nanagin maayo ang Ginoo sa iya bangud pagkatapos sang duha ka adlaw nga pagpahuway kag pagpangamuyo, gin pamatian ini sang Diyos.
english: He went to church to pray and again the Lord was good to him because after two days of rest and prayer, God heard him.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ang kadalag-an nagadepende gid sa preparasyon, kag ang pinakadaku nga fulfillment para sa ila amo ang makita nga gin-appreciate sang katawhan ang ila ginpangabudlayan.
english: He said that success depends on preparation, and the biggest fulfillment for them is to see that the people appreciate their hard work.

text: Dugang pa niya nga indi matakos ang ila kalipay nga mabatyagan ilabi na kun sila ang palakpakan sang mga tawo nga nakasaksi sang ila sakripisyo kag kabudlayan sa kada kompetisyon nga sila kabahin.
english: He added that their happiness is incomparable especially when they are applauded by the people who witnessed their sacrifice and hard work in every competition they participated in.

text: PARA sa akon ang Jeepney Modernization Program “anti-poor”, ukon kontra-imol, kag kontra man sa panugyan sang Konstitusyon  nga naga-encourage sang “private (free) enterprise”.
english: FOR me the Jeepney Modernization Program is “anti-poor”, or anti-poor, and also contrary to the Constitution’s advice to encourage “private (free) enterprise”.

text: Ang Constitution sa State Policies, Sec.
english: The Constitution on State Policies, Sec.

text:
20, sa kabug-usan, nagasiling: “The State recognizes the indispensable role of the private sector, encourages private enterprise, and provides incentives to needed investments.”

Ining provision sa private enterprise nagatumod sa hilway nga pagnegosyo, samtang dapat may pagbulig man diri ang gobyerno sa pagpasanyog sang pangabuhi sang magagmay nga mga negosyante.
english:
20, in sum, states: “The State recognizes the indispensable role of the private sector, encourages private enterprise, and provides incentives to needed investments.”

This provision on private enterprise refers to free enterprise, while the government should also be involved in improving the livelihoods of small businesses.

text: Natural lang nga sa idalom sang private enterprise may kinamatarong ang mga negosyante sa pagpakig-kumpetensya sa pagganyat sa mga kustomer agud baklon ang ila produkto, basta sa matarong lang nga paagi.
english: Naturally, under private enterprise, entrepreneurs have the right to compete in attracting customers to buy their products, provided that they do so in a fair manner.

text: Ang indi matarong nga paagi nagalakip sang “unfair competition” kag monopoliya, ukon pag-kontrol sang negosyo sang isa ukon pila lang ka negosyante.
english: Unfair practices include “unfair competition” and monopoly, or control of business by one or a few businessmen.

text: Ang Sec.
english: The Sec.

text: 9 nagapanunyag man: “The State shall promote a just and dynamic social order (that will)…free the people from poverty…” Indi agud itum-ok pa gid ang mga pigado, labi na gid kay ining programa nagahatag pa sa mga manggaran sing bentaha sa ila na nga daan maayo nga kahimtangan.
english: 9 also states: “The State shall promote a just and dynamic social order (that will)…free the people from poverty…” Not to further oppress the poor, especially since this program still gives the rich an advantage over their already good condition.

text: In other words, ang Jeepney Modernization Program taliwas sa ginapanugyan sang aton Konstitusyon sa nahinambitan na nga mga provision.
english: In other words, the Jeepney Modernization Program is contrary to what our Constitution recommends in the above-mentioned provisions.

text: Maathag nga anti-free enterprise ini sa pagdikta sa kon sin-o ang magpartisipar diri kag kon pila ang gastuhon nila, nga wala sing pagkabalaka labi na gid ang indibdwal kag magagmay nga mga operator nga masobra seguro mga 100,000.
english: It is clearly anti-free enterprise to dictate who participates here and how much they spend, without concern especially individuals and small operators who are probably more than 100,000.

text: Dapat tagaan ini sila sang choice ukon kinamatarong sa pagpili sang mapahanugutan nga klase sang salakyan santu lang sa ila ikasarang kag luyag.
english: They should be given the choice or right to choose the permissible type of vehicle based on their ability and desire.

text: Madamo sa aton mga operator may espesyal gani nga pagkahamuot sa jeepney, nga bunga sang “ingenuity” sang Filipino nga nagahatag bugal sa aton tanan.
english: Many of our operators even have a special fondness for the jeepney, which is the result of the Filipino ingenuity that makes us all proud.

text: Ti, ngaa pabaklon gid kita sang ubra sang pangayaw nga manufacturer samtang yara man ang mga lokal nga manufacturer nga experto na sa pag-ubra sini, katulad sang Sarao Motors kag pila pa ka lokal nga mga manufacturer nga makuha nila sing mas barato?
english: Well, why should we buy the work of a foreign manufacturer when there are local manufacturers who are already experts in doing it, such as Sarao Motors and some other local manufacturers that they can get cheaper?

text: Ang ginatugyan sang DOTr amo ang ubra sining mga pangayaw ng manufacturer nga magabili sing P1.2 tubtub P1.6 ka milyon, samtang makuha nila ini sa Sarao Motors kag iban pa sa mga P500,000 lang samtang santu man sa gina-requirer sang gobyerno, katulad sang paggamit sang 4BC1 nga four-cycle engine.
english: The DOTr is entrusting the work of these foreign manufacturers which will cost P1.2 to P1.6 million, while they can get it from Sarao Motors and others for only P500,000 while also in accordance with the government's requirements, such as the use of 4BC1 four-cycle engine.

text: Indi lang paghatag ini sang dugang nga huol sa magagmay nga mga operator, kundi pagpalabi pa ini sa mga dalagku nga negosyo nga amo gid ang makabentaha sa sining programa, sa lugar nga makabulig sa mga pigado.
english: This is not only putting more pressure on small operators, but also giving preference to large businesses that will benefit from this program, instead of helping the poor.

text: Ang pagpilit sa mga operator sa luyag gid sang gobyerno taliwas ini sa gina-encourage sang Konstitusyon nga private, ukon, free enpterise.
english: Forcing operators to do what the government wants is contrary to the Constitution's encouragement of private, or, free enpterise.

text: Diniktador ina ya!
english: He's a dictator!

text: Pabay-i lang ang operator ang maghimo sang ila desisyon sa diin indi man sila matam-an.
english: Let the operator make their decision where they will not be overwhelmed.

text: Magamay man lang gani ang mabulig sang goberno sa ila problema, ti ngaa mamilit gid ini sang iya luyag nga ang operator man ang makarga sang kahul-anan?
english: The government can do little to help them with their problems, so why does it insist that the operator bear the burden?

text: In short, ang ining Jeepney Modernization Program anti-poor kag anti-free enterprise, nga kontra sang Konstitusyon.
english: In short, this Jeepney Modernization Program is anti-poor and anti-free enterprise, which is against the Constitution.

text: Nagaupod kita  sa tanan nga nagasikway sini – ang mga magagmay nga mga operator kag indi!
english: We stand with all those who reject it – small operators and not!

Sa isa ka pahayag nga ginpaguwa, kasunod sang tatlo ka adlaw nga Plenary (Pebrero 19-21), ang Paris-based Financial Action Task Force (FATF) nag-anunsyo nga ang Pilipinas wala na sa idalom sang dugang nga monitoring.
english:

text: Kon ang Financial Action Task Force nagabutang sang isa ka pungsod sa idalom sang “grey list” ukon dugang nga pagbantay, nagakahulugan ini nga ang isa ka pungsod nagkomiter sa pagresolba sang nakilala nga mga strategic deficiencies sa sulod sang ginkasugtan nga timeframes kag napaidalom sa dugang nga monitoring.
english: When the Financial Action Task Force places a country under a “grey list” or increased monitoring, it means that a country has committed to resolving identified strategic deficiencies within agreed timeframes and is subject to increased monitoring.

text: Nagbanta si Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic ng mahigpit na aksyon laban sa mga anti-government protesters, kasunod ng ilang araw na kaguluhan at riot sa iba’t ibang bahagi ng Serbia, na kinikilala bilang pinakamalaking hamon sa kanyang pamumuno.
english: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic has threatened strict action against anti-government protesters, following several days of unrest and riots in various parts of Serbia, which is seen as the biggest challenge to his leadership.

text: Sa kanyang pahayag nitong Linggo, tinawag ni Vucic ang mga kilos-protesta bilang “pure terrorism” at iginiit na ang mga ito ay bahagi umano ng isang planong sinusuportahan ng mga kanluraning bansa upang sirain ang Serbia.
english: In his statement on Sunday, Vucic called the protests "pure terrorism" and insisted that they were part of a plan backed by Western countries to destroy Serbia.

text: Aniya, layon umano ng mga nagpoprotesta na itaguyod ang “anarcho-leftist” na pamahalaan sa hinaharap, ngunit hindi siya nagpakita ng ebidensya upang patunayan ito.
english: He said the protesters are trying to promote an “anarcho-leftist” government in the future, but he did not show evidence to prove it.

text: Ayon sa kanya, nasa panganib ang bansa at kailangang magpatupad ng mas mahigpit na hakbang upang maiwasan ang lalong paglala ng sitwasyon.
english: According to him, the country is in danger and needs to implement stricter measures to avoid further deterioration of the situation.

text: Binigyang-diin niyang hindi pa ipatutupad ang state of emergency, ngunit tiniyak niyang maglalabas ng konkretong tugon ang estado sa loob ng isang linggo.

text: Pareho nga nagnubo ang approval and trust ratings nanday President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag Vice President Sara Duterte base sa resulta sang latest survey sang Pulse Asia nga gin-conduct halin sang Nobyembre 26-Disyembre 3.
english: and Vice President Sara Duterte based on the results of the latest survey of Pulse Asia conducted from November 26-December 3.

text: Nakasaad nga nagpanaog ang approval rating ni Marcos sa 48 percent halin sa 50 percent nga iya nakuha sang Septyembre.
english: Marcos' approval rating dropped to 48 percent from 50 percent in September.

text: Ang iya trust rating nag-us-os man sa 47 percent halin sa 50 percent sang amo man nga bulan.
english: His trust rating also slipped to 47 percent from 50 percent the same month.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagtupa na lamang sa 50 percent ang approval rating para sa bise-presidente nga may double-digit ukon 10-point decrease halin sa 60 percent nga iya gin-enjoy sang Septyembre.
english: Meanwhile, the approval rating for the vice-president has fallen to 50 percent with a double-digit or 10-point decrease from the 60 percent he enjoyed in September.

text: Nagsarurot man ang iya trust rating sa 49 percent halin sa 61 percent sang nasambit nga bulan.
english: His trust rating also dropped to 49 percent from 61 percent last month.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nakabaton si Senate President Chiz Escudero sang highest approval kag trust scores nga may 53 percent kag 51 percent.
english: Meanwhile, Senate President Chiz Escudero received the highest approval and trust scores with 53 percent and 51 percent respectively.

text: Ang pinakamanubo naman nga ratings amo ang iya ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga may approval kag trust scores nga yara sa 44 percent.
english: The lowest ratings were for House Speaker Martin Romualdez with approval and trust scores of 44 percent.

text: Ginpatigayon ang survey kadungan sang pila ka dalagku nga developments sa pungsod kaangay sang impeachment cases nga gin-file batok kay Sara sa una nga semana sang Disyembre.
english: The survey was conducted amid several major developments in the country such as the impeachment cases filed against Sara in the first week of December.

text: Dungan man ini sa pagpakita na ni former President Rodrigo Duterte sa House Quad Committee nga naga-imbestigar sa drug war.

text: Natabo man ang survey sang ginpirmahan ni Marcos ang duha ka layi nga nagaplastar sang boundaries sang Philippine maritime zones agud pangapinan ang teritoryo sang Pilipinas.

text: Gin-conduct ang survey sa 2,400 respondents nga nagaedad 18-anyos pasaka sa bilog nga pungsod.

text: May yara ini sang ±2 percent error margin sa 95 percent confidence level.

english: The 45th ASEAN Tourism Forum (ATF) 2026 opened today in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, marking the return of the Philippines as host after nearly a decade.

text: Sa temang “Navigating Our Tourism Future Together,” itinatampok ng forum ang papel ng bansa sa pagpapaunlad ng turismo sa Timog-Silangang Asya, integrasyon ng rehiyon, at pangmatagalang paglago.
english: Under the theme “Navigating Our Tourism Future Together,” the forum highlights the country’s role in tourism development in Southeast Asia, regional integration, and sustainable development.

text: Inaasahang dadalo sa opening ceremony si First Lady Liza Marcos.
english: First Lady Liza Marcos is expected to attend the opening ceremony.

text: Ayon sa Department of Tourism (DOT), layunin ng ATF 2026 na magdala ng sustained international attention, mas maraming turista, at mas mataas na negosyo sa bansa.
english: According to the Department of Tourism (DOT), ATF 2026 aims to bring sustained international attention, more tourists, and higher business to the country.

text: Dito rin magtatagpo ang mga tourism ministers, opisyal ng National Tourism Organizations, at lider ng industriya mula sa ASEAN at mga partner mula sa China, Japan, South Korea, India, Russia, Australia, at United States–ASEAN Business Council.
english: Tourism ministers, officials of National Tourism Organizations, and industry leaders from ASEAN and partners from China, Japan, South Korea, India, Russia, Australia, and the United States–ASEAN Business Council will also meet here.

text: Kasama sa mga aktibidad ang ASEAN Tourism Ministerial Meeting, ASEAN Tourism Conference, at paglulunsad ng ASEAN Tourism Sectoral Plan 2026–2030, na naglalayong itaguyod ang sustainable at inclusive tourism sa rehiyon.
english: Activities include the ASEAN Tourism Ministerial Meeting, ASEAN Tourism Conference, and the launch of the ASEAN Tourism Sectoral Plan 2026–2030, which aims to promote sustainable and inclusive tourism in the region.

text: Bukas din ang TRAVEX 2026, ASEAN’s flagship tourism trade exchange, mula Enero 28–30 sa Mactan Expo, na nagtitipon ng mahigit 700 international buyers at sellers.
english: TRAVEX 2026, ASEAN’s flagship tourism trade exchange, will also be open from January 28–30 at the Mactan Expo, bringing together more than 700 international buyers and sellers.

text: Tampok rin ang mga cultural tours gaya ng “Paglantaw” sa Old Cebu at “Bagani” sa Lapu-Lapu City.
english: Cultural tours such as “Paglantaw” in Old Cebu and “Bagani” in Lapu-Lapu City are also featured.

text: Ayon kay Tourism Secretary Christina Garcia Frasco, ang forum ay ekonomikong oportunidad at pagpapakita ng Pilipinas bilang lider sa ASEAN tourism, na nagtataguyod ng kooperasyon, inobasyon, at sustainable development sa buong rehiyon.
english: According to Tourism Secretary Christina Garcia Frasco, the forum is an economic opportunity and showcase of the Philippines as a leader in ASEAN tourism, promoting cooperation, innovation, and sustainable development throughout the region.

text: Nagpasugot na ang Hamas sa peace proposal halin sa mga regional mediators.
english: Hamas has agreed to a peace proposal from regional mediators.

text: Ang proposal halin sa Egypt kag Qatar ang ginalakipan sang pag-release sang mga bihag kag ang ceasefire deal sa ila sang Israel.
english: The proposal from Egypt and Qatar includes the release of the hostages and a ceasefire deal with them by Israel.

text: Base ini sa two-stage framework nga ginpasa sa ila ni US envoy Steve Witkoff sang Hunyo.
english: This is based on the two-stage framework that US envoy Steve Witkoff passed to them in June.

english: It shows that Hamas has released about 50 remaining Israeli hostages.

english: Of the hostages, 20 are still alive and will be released in two batches during the 60-day ceasefire until a permanent ceasefire is reached.

text: Naka-save sang masobra P6.3 million ang Iloilo Provincial Government sa sulod sang isa ka tuig paagi sa paggamit sang solar panel energy sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol kag sa mga district hospital sa probinsya.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government has saved more than P6.3 million in one year by using solar panel energy at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol and district hospitals in the province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Atty. Cesar Emanuelle Buyco, head sang Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PENRO), nga nag-invest ang probinsya sang humalin P25 million para sa pag-install sang solar panels.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Cesar Emanuelle Buyco, head of the Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PENRO), said the province has invested more than P25 million for the installation of solar panels.

text: Suno sa iya, kabahin ini sang inisyatibo sang probinsya agud mangin mas mangin innovative kag epektibo sa paggamit sang enerhiya.
english: He said this is part of the province's initiative to be more innovative and efficient in the use of energy.

text: Imbes nga dako nga kantidad ang mabaydan sa mga power provider, nakakinot ang probinsya sang P6.3 million nga mahimo pa magamit sa nagkalain-lain nga proyekto sang gobyerno.
english: Instead of paying large sums to power providers, the province saved P6.3 million that could have been used for various government projects.

text: Pahayag ni Buyco, dako gid ang bulig sang solar energy ilabi na sa mga ospital, bangud kadako sang nabuhin nga balayran sa kuryente sang tagsa ka district hospital sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Buyco said solar energy is a big help especially to hospitals, because of the huge reduction in electricity bills of each district hospital in Iloilo province.

text: Suno pa kay Buyco, ang solar panel system ang ginapaabot nga magalawig sang 15 ka tuig, nga magapadayon nga magahatag benepisyo sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol kag sa mga ospital.
english: Buyco said the solar panel system is expected to last 15 years, which will continue to benefit the Iloilo Provincial Capitol and hospitals.

text: Gindugang pa niya nga ang mga nakinot nga pondo mahimo liwat i-reinvest sa pagbakal kag pag-install pa sang dugang nga solar panels.
english: He added that the saved funds can be reinvested in the purchase and installation of more solar panels.

text: Sa karon, ginaplano man sang Iloilo Provincial Government nga ipatuman ang pareho nga proyekto sa mga buluthuan, bilang kabahin sang amat-amat nga transition sa renewable energy sa probinsya.

text: Ini isa ka tikang nga ginakabig nga makahagan-hagan kag makabulig indi lamang sa gobyerno kundi pati na sa palibot.

text: Ginpunto man sang ICAST nga ang Dinagyang Festival isa sa pinaka-importante nga aktibidad sang Iloilo City, gani ila gid ginatagaan sang importansya ang pagpatuman sang mga ordinansa, kaangay sang anti-smoking ordinance.
english: ICAST also pointed out that the Dinagyang Festival is one of the most important activities of Iloilo City, so they give importance to the implementation of ordinances, such as the anti-smoking ordinance.

text: Nakaluwas sa kamatayon ang 58-anyos nga lalaki sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika matapos nangin madinalag-on ang ginhimo sang mga doktor nga pagsaylo sang korason sang baboy sa lawas sang amo nga lalaki.
english: A 58-year-old man in the United States of America survived after doctors successfully transplanted a pig's heart into his body.

text: Ang pasyente amo si Lawrence Faucette, isa ka Navy veteran kag residente sang Frederick, Maryland.
english: The patient was Lawrence Faucette, a Navy veteran and resident of Frederick, Maryland.

text: Ginbalikan ni Faucette ang tyempo kun sa diin ang iya option amo ang xenotransplant ukon ang pagbaton niya sang organ halin sa sapat — ukon sa sini nga kaso, heart sang baboy.
english: Faucette recalled the time when his option was a xenotransplant or receiving an organ from an animal — or in this case, a pig's heart.

text: Suno sa Navy veteran, ginkapyutan niya ang gamay kaayo nga tyansa kag wala gid siya nagsala sa desisyon bangud kasunod sang madinalag-on nga transplant, maka-ginhawa na siya sang maayo, matalunsay na ang pitik sang iya korason, kag naga-gana ini nga wala nagakinahanglan sang supportive device.
english: According to the Navy veteran, he grabbed the very small chance and he never made a mistake in his decision because after the successful transplant, he can breathe well, his heart beats smoothly, and it works without the need for a supportive device.

text: Ang gina-inom lang sini subong amo ang conventional anti-rejection drugs amo man ang bag-o nga antibody therapy agud nga punggan ang iya lawas nga i-damage ukon i-reject ang bag-o nga organ.
english: All he is taking now are conventional anti-rejection drugs as well as a new antibody therapy to prevent his body from damaging or rejecting the new organ.

text: Ang operasyon kay Faucette ang ginpangunahan sang mga eksperto kag mga doktor halin sa University of Maryland School of Medicine.
english: Faucette’s surgery was led by experts and doctors from the University of Maryland School of Medicine.

text: Ang amo man nga team ang nagpatigayon sang labing-una nga transplant sang korason sang baboy sa tawo sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The same team conducted the first-ever pig-to-human heart transplant last year.

text: Sang amo nga tion, duha ka bulan pa nga nagkabuhi ang 57-anyos nga pasyente nga si David Bennett matapos ang transplant apang napatay man bangud maluya na nga daan ini antes pa man ang operasyon.
english: At the time, 57-year-old patient David Bennett lived two months after the transplant but also died because he was already weak before the operation.

text: Ang xenotransplant sa USA amo ang ginalantaw nga makahatag sang solusyon sa chronic shortage sang human organ donations.
english: Xenotransplant in the USA is therefore expected to provide a solution to the chronic shortage of human organ donations.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong, masobra 100,000 ka Americans ang nagahulat para sa organ transplants.
english: Currently, more than 100,000 Americans are waiting for organ transplants.

text: Ginkabos ang Philippine men’s national football team nga maka-abante kuntani sa labing-una nga tion sa finals sang ASEAN Championship.
english: The Philippine men’s national football team, which was supposed to advance for the first time to the finals of the ASEAN Championship, was eliminated.

text: Ini matapos nalutos sa powerhouse team sang Thailand, 3-1, sa extra time sang second leg sang semifinals subong nga gab-i sa Rajamangala Stadium sa Bangkok.
english: This after losing to powerhouse team Thailand, 3-1, in extra time of the second leg of the semifinals tonight at the Rajamangala Stadium in Bangkok.

text: Una nga naka-skor para sa defending champions si Peeradon Chamratsamee sa ika-37 nga minuto sang hampang kag ginsundan ni Patrik Gustavson sa 54th minute.
english: Peeradon Chamratsamee scored first for the defending champions in the 37th minute of the match followed by Patrik Gustavson in the 54th minute.

text: Wala nagpangampo ang Pilipinas kag nabuhian sang paglaum sang naka-goal si Bjorn Martin Kristensen sa 84th minute nga amo ang nagpatas sa aggregate score sang duha ka mga team, 3-3.
english: The Philippines did not give up and were given hope when Bjorn Martin Kristensen scored in the 84th minute to tie the aggregate score of the two teams, 3-3.

text: Pag-abot sa extra time, diri na kag nakuha sang Thais ang kadalag-an nga ginkahugyaw sang malapit 32,000 fans sa home field matapos nagsulod ang star striker nga si Suphanat Mueanta bilang substitute.
english: In extra time, the Thais won the victory that was cheered by nearly 32,000 fans at home after star striker Suphanat Mueanta came on as a substitute.

text: Ang iya late header sa 116th minute amo ang dalayon nga nagpa-abante sa powerhouse team sa finals paagi sa 4-3 aggregate.
english: His late header in the 116th minute consistently put the powerhouse team ahead in the finals by 4-3 aggregate.

text: Antes ang Leg 2, matandaan nga ginpatilaw anay sang Pilipinas ang Thailand sang mapait nga kalutusan sa imbukada sang semifinals, 2-1.
english: Before Leg 2, it can be recalled that the Philippines had tasted a bitter defeat to Thailand in the opening of the semifinals, 2-1.

text: Ini ang una nga pagdaog sang Pilipinas batok sa Thai booters sa sulod sang masobra lima ka dekada.
english: This is the first win for the Philippines against Thai booters in more than five decades.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Thailand ang Vietnam sa final game.
english: Thailand will next face Vietnam in the final game.

text: Kun sila ang magdaog, ini na ang ila ikatatlo nga sunod-sunod nga korona sa sini nga tournament.
english: If they win, it will be their third consecutive crown in this tournament.

text: Nagpaguwa sang executive order si Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas nga nagasuspinde sang klase sa tanan nga lebel sa mga eskwelahan sa distrito sang Jaro sa Lunes, Pebrero 2.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas issued an executive order suspending classes at all levels in schools in Jaro district on Monday, February 2.

text: Kadungan ini sang Jaro fiesta ukon ang kapistahan ni Nuestra Señora dela Candelaria nga amo ang patrona sang Western Visayas.
english: This coincides with the Jaro fiesta or the feast of Nuestra Señora dela Candelaria who is the patron saint of Western Visayas.

text: Kinaandan nga nagadugok ang linibo nga mga deboto halin sa Rehiyon 6 kag sa iban pa nga mga lugar kadungan sini nga kapistahan.
english: Thousands of devotees from Region 6 and other areas usually gather during this festival.

text: Suno sa alkalde, ginrekomendar ni Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Traffic and Transportation Management Office, ang suspension sang klase bangud sa natalana nga pagsirado sang mga mayor nga dalanon nga pagahiwatan sang religious celebration.
english: The mayor said Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Traffic and Transportation Management Office, recommended the suspension of classes due to the scheduled closure of major roads for religious celebrations.

text: “Bangud sang ginaasahan nga pagtaas sa foot traffic, traffic congestion, kag road closures kadungan sang Feast of the Lady of Candles, gin suspend ni Mayor Raisa Treñas ang face-to-face classes sa tanan nga lebel, sa tanan nga eskwelahan sa Distrito sang Jaro, Iloilo City sa Pebrero 2, 2026,” suno sa post ni Mayor Treñas.
english: “Due to the expected increase in foot traffic, traffic congestion, and road closures during the Feast of the Lady of Candles, Mayor Raisa Treñas has suspended face-to-face classes at all levels, in all schools in the District of Jaro, Iloilo City on February 2, 2026,” Mayor Treñas said in a post.

text: Sa executive order sang alkalde, gina-engganyo man sini ang mga institusyon ukon eskwelahan sa guwa sang distrito sang Jaro nga mag-suspend man sang face-to-face classes kun maapektuhan man sila sang pagsirado sang mga dalan kag serye sang religious kag cultural events sa pista.
english: In the executive order, the mayor also encouraged institutions or schools outside the Jaro district to suspend face-to-face classes if they are affected by the closure of roads and a series of religious and cultural events during the festival.

text: Ginatugyan naman sang alkalde sa discretion sang mga pinuno sang government agencies kag sa mga private business owners kun maga-suspinde sila sang trabaho sa amo nga adlaw.
english: The mayor said it is up to the discretion of the heads of government agencies and private business owners whether to suspend work on that day.
