text:
Masobra sa 40 ka mga indibidwal ang ginapangita subong matapos maglugdang ang isa ka sakayan pandagat nga may sakay nga 50 ka mga pasahero sa Sokoto State, northwest sang Nigeria,

Ini ang gin-anunsyo sang National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA).
english:
More than 40 individuals are currently wanted after a sea vessel carrying 50 passengers sank in Sokoto State, northwest Nigeria,

This was announced by the National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA).

text: Ang mga pasahero ang nagabiyahe padulong sa Goronyo Market, isa sa mga kilala nga merkado sang pagkaon sa nasambit nga estado, sang nagluntad ang trahedya.
english: The passengers were on their way to Goronyo Market, one of the state’s well-known food markets, when the tragedy struck.

text: Suno kay Zubaidar Umar, head sang NEMA, 10 ka mga tawo na ang na-rescue samtang ang iban padayon pa nga ginapangita.
english: According to Zubaidar Umar, head of NEMA, 10 people have been rescued while others are still being searched.

text: Ginpahayag man sang ahensya nga yara na sila subong sa koordinasyon upod sa mga lokal nga otoridad kag emergency responders para sa padayon nga search and rescue operations.
english: The agency also said they are now in coordination with local authorities and emergency responders for ongoing search and rescue operations.

text: Matandaan nga indi man magnubo sa 13 ka mga tawo kag madamo ang missing matapos nga naglugdang ang barko nga nagadala sang ginabanta 100 ka pasahero sa Niger State sa north-central Nigeria, tatlo ka semana ang nakaligad.
english: It can be recalled that at least 13 people and many are missing after a ship carrying about 100 passengers sank in Niger State in north-central Nigeria, three weeks ago.

text: USA – Ang pag-inom sang madamo nga tubig sa sulod sang isa ka adlaw ang masami nga ginapanugyan agud nga makalikaw sa dehydration.
english: USA – Drinking plenty of water throughout the day is usually recommended in order to avoid dehydration.

text: Magluwas diri, ini ang makapaayo man sa tanan nga nagapaidalom sa diet.
english: In addition, it is also healthy for all those undergoing a diet.

text: Sa pagpa-athag ni Dr. Tammy Chang, assistant professor of family medicine sa University of Michigan Medical School, ang regular nga pag-inom sang tubig ang makapanubo sang Body Mass Index sang tawo.
english: In the explanation of Dr. Tammy Chang, assistant professor of family medicine at the University of Michigan Medical School, regular water intake can reduce a person’s Body Mass Index.

text: Halos 50% suno kay Chang ang kahigayunan nga makalikaw sa obesity ukon tuman nga katambukon.
english: Chang said the chances of avoiding obesity are almost 50%.

text: Suno naman kay Connie Diekman, director of university nutrition sa Washington University sa Estados Unidos, ang paglikaw sa dehydration ang indi lamang paagi sa pag-inom sang tubig kundi paagi man sa pagkaon sang prutas kag laswa.
english: According to Connie Diekman, director of university nutrition at Washington University in the United States, avoiding dehydration is not only by drinking water but also by eating fruits and vegetables.

text: Gin-athag man ni Diekman nga mas ginakinahanglan sang mga matambok nga tawo nga magkaon sang prutas kag laswa.
english: Diekman also explained that obese people need to eat more fruits and vegetables.

text: Ginapanugyan naman sang mga eksperto nga 3.6 liters sang tubig ang dapat nga mainom sang mga lalaki sa sulod sang isa ka adlaw samtang 2.7 liters naman para sa mga babayi.
english: Experts recommend that men drink 3.6 liters of water a day while women drink 2.7 liters.

text: Inaasahang ililikas sa mga darating na linggo ang nasa 30 hanggang 50 batang Palestinian na malubha ang karamdaman o sugatan mula Gaza patungong United Kingdom (UK) upang tumanggap ng medikal na atensyon, ayon sa ulat ng BBC.
english: Between 30 and 50 seriously ill or injured Palestinian children are expected to be evacuated from Gaza to the United Kingdom (UK) in the coming weeks, according to a BBC report.

text: Ito ang unang pagkakataon na magdadala ang UK ng mga batang Palestinian sa ilalim ng isang opisyal na operasyon ng pamahalaan, sa koordinasyon ng Foreign Office, Home Office, at Department of Health.
english: This is the first time the UK will take Palestinian children under an official government operation, in coordination with the Foreign Office, Home Office, and Department of Health.

text: Ang pagpili sa mga bata ay isasagawa ng World Health Organization (WHO), at sasamahan sila ng mga kamag-anak sa upang umalalay kung saan isasagawa ang biometric screening.
english: The selection of children will be conducted by the World Health Organization (WHO), and they will be accompanied by relatives to the front where biometric screening will be conducted.

text: Ang hakbang ay kasunod ng panawagan ng 96 miyembro ng parliament mula sa iba’t ibang partido na agarang tulungan ang mga batang nangangailangan ng medikal na atensyon, sa gitna ng halos tuluyang pagbagsak ng sistemang pangkalusugan sa Gaza.
english: The move follows a call by 96 members of parliament from various parties to immediately help children in need of medical attention, amid the almost complete collapse of the health system in Gaza.

text: Una nang may ilang bata ang dinala sa UK sa pamamagitan ng isang pribadong organisasyon ngunit ito naman ang kauna-unahang opisyal na programa ng gobyerno sa ilalim ng tumitinding sigalot sa rehiyon.
english: Earlier, some children were brought to the UK through a private organization but this is the first official government program under the escalating conflict in the region.

text: Wala pang tiyak na detalye kung anong bansa ang magiging transit point, ilan eksakto ang maililikas, o kung may kasunod pang grupo ang pupunta sa UK.
english: There are no definite details on which country will be the transit point, exactly how many will be evacuated, or if there will be another group heading to the UK.

text: Dahil sa kahirapan ng pagbabalik sa Gaza, posible umanong pumasok sa asylum system ng UK ang ilan sa mga batang ito pagkatapos ng gamutan.
english: Due to the difficulty of returning to Gaza, it is possible that some of these children will re-enter the UK asylum system after being treated.

text: Samantala batay sa datos ng UNICEF, mahigit 50,000 batang Palestinian na ang nasawi o nasugatan simula nang magsimula ang digmaan noong Oktubre 2023.
english: Meanwhile, according to UNICEF data, more than 50,000 Palestinian children have been killed or injured since the conflict began in October 2023.

text: Higit 60,000 katao naman ang naiulat na nasawi sa Gaza ayon sa Hamas-run health ministry.
english: More than 60,000 people have been reported stranded in Gaza, according to the Hamas-run health ministry.

text: Magugunitang ang opensiba ng Israel ay tugon sa pag-atake ng Hamas sa Israel noong Oktubre 7, 2023, kung saan humigit-kumulang 1,200 katao ang napatay at 251 ang binihag.
english: The Israeli offensive is in response to the Hamas attack on Israel on October 7, 2023, which killed approximately 1,200 people and took 251 captives.

text: Dismayado ang kampo ni former President Rodrigo Duterte bangud wala sila ginpahanugutan nga magpresentar sang ila kaugalingon nga medical evidence kaangot sa ginaalegar nila nga pagluya sang kondisyon sang anay presidente.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's camp is disappointed that they were not allowed to present their own medical evidence regarding the former president's alleged deteriorating condition.

text: Ini ang kasunod sa ginpagwa nga deklarasyon sang International Criminal Court (ICC) Pre-Trial Chamber 1 nga dapat mag-atubang si Duterte sa pre-trial proceedings bangud “fit” ini sandig sa ginpatigayon nga assessment sang mga medical expert.
english: This follows the declaration issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC) Pre-Trial Chamber 1 that Duterte should face pre-trial proceedings because he is “fit” based on the assessment conducted by medical experts.

text: Suno naman kay Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, lead counsel ni Duterte, maga-file sila sang apela kag iga-insister nga wala nahatagan sang due process si Duterte.
english: According to Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, Duterte's lead counsel, said they will file an appeal and insist that Duterte was not given due process.

text: “The Defence is disappointed that, contrary to accepted practice, it was denied the opportunity to present its own medical evidence and to question, in court, the contradictory findings of professionals selected by the judges.
english: “The Defense is disappointed that, contrary to accepted practice, it was denied the opportunity to present its own medical evidence and to question, in court, the contradictory findings of professionals selected by the judges.

text: The Defence will seek leave to appeal this decision and argue that Mr. Duterte was denied due process,” suno sa abogado sang former president.
english: The Defense will seek leave to appeal this decision and argue that Mr. Duterte was denied due process,” the former president’s lawyer said.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa ginpaguwa nga 25 ka pahina nga desisyon, ginbasura sang ICC ang request sang kampo ni Duterte para sa indefinite adjournment sang kaso.
english: In a 25-page decision, the ICC rejected the Duterte camp's request for an indefinite adjournment of the case.

text: Gin-schedule man sang chamber ang pag-umpisa sang confirmation of charges hearing sa Pebrero 23, 2026.
english: The chamber also scheduled the start of the confirmation of charges hearing on February 23, 2026.

text: Matandaan nga may panel sang medical experts nga nag-check sa ikaayong lawas sang anay presidente matapos nga gin-alegar sang kampo sini nga malipaton na si Duterte kag indi na makadumdom sang mga hitabo, mga petsa, kag mangin sa iya pamilya.
english: It can be recalled that a panel of medical experts checked the health of the former president after his camp alleged that Duterte is forgetful and cannot remember events, dates, and even his family.

text: Una naman nga ginbasura sang korte ang ila request para sa interim release.
english: The court earlier rejected their request for interim release.

text: Marso 11, 2025 sang gindakop si Duterte kag gindala sa The Hague, Netherlands bangud sa kaso nga nag-ugat sa kontrobersyal sini nga drug war.
english: On March 11, 2025, Duterte was arrested and brought to The Hague, Netherlands on charges stemming from his controversial drug war.

text: Ni-relieve sa pwesto ang 46 na hepe sa Western Visayas kabilang ang lima mula sa Lungsod ng Iloilo.
english: Forty-six chiefs in Western Visayas, including five from Iloilo City, were relieved of their posts.

text: Naging epektibo ang relief order kahapon, Enero 30, kasunod ng inilabas na Issuance of Orders for Reassignment at Resolution 2026-01.
english: The relief order became effective yesterday, January 30, following the issuance of Issuance of Orders for Reassignment and Resolution 2026-01.

text: Bukod sa limang hepe mula sa Iloilo City Police Office, may 11 na mula sa Antique Police Provincial Office, anim mula sa Aklan Police Provincial Office, 10 mula sa Capiz Police Provincial Office, isa mula sa Guimaras Police Provincial Office, at 13 mula sa Iloilo Police Provincial Office.
english: Besides the five chiefs from the Iloilo City Police Office, there are 11 from the Antique Police Provincial Office, six from the Aklan Police Provincial Office, 10 from the Capiz Police Provincial Office, one from the Guimaras Police Provincial Office, and 13 from the Iloilo Police Provincial Office.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Lailyn Sencil, tagapagsalita ng Police Regional Office VI, sinabi niya na ang reassignment na ito ay bahagi ng regular na prosesong administratibo o rotation ng mga commander na nakapagsilbi na ng isa hanggang dalawang taon o higit pa bilang hepe.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Major Lailyn Sencil, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office VI, said the reassignment is part of the regular administrative process or rotation of commanders who have served one to two years or more as chiefs.

text: Aniya, ito ay pinag-usapan at isinailalim sa proseso ng Second Level Officers Placement Board upang matiyak ang transparency, objectivity, at mahigpit na pagsunod sa umiiral na mga patakaran at alituntunin ng PNP.
english: He said this was discussed and subjected to the process of the Second Level Officers Placement Board to ensure transparency, objectivity, and strict compliance with the existing policies and guidelines of the PNP.

text: Nilinaw ng opisina na ito ay karaniwang ginagawa ng PNP at walang sangkot na kaparusahan.
english: The office clarified that this is a normal action of the PNP and there is no punishment involved.

text: Hindi pa tinukoy kung saan itatalaga ang mga inireliebo na hepe, ngunit ayon kay Sencil, may ilan na ia-assign sa regional headquarters.
english: It is not yet specified where the relieved chiefs will be assigned, but according to Sencil, some will be assigned to regional headquarters.

text: Malipayon ka pa bala sa inyo relasyon sang imo nobyo ukon nobya?
english: Are you still happy in your relationship with your boyfriend or girlfriend?

text: Mas madamo pa bala ang away niyo kun ipaanggid sa pag-mayohay ninyo nga duha?
english: Do you have more fights than you two get along?

text: Mahimo nga yara ikaw sa isa ka toxic nga relasyon.
english: You may be in a toxic relationship.

text: Indi mo lang ma mulalungan apang nagaka-apektuhan na ang inyo ikaayong lawas.
english: You can't just ignore it but it's affecting your health.

text: Suno kay Linda Weinberger, professor sa clinical psychiatry and behavioral sciences sa Keck School of Medicine sang University of Southern California, ang healthy relationship ang nagahatag sa imo sang kalipay kag naga pa energize pa sa imo samtang ang toxic relationship naman ang nagahatag sa imo sang depression kag kalain sang buot.
english: According to Linda Weinberger, professor of clinical psychiatry and behavioral sciences at the University of Southern California's Keck School of Medicine, a healthy relationship makes you feel happy and energized while a toxic relationship makes you feel depressed and sad.

text: Kun yara ikaw sa toxic nga relasyon, dako ang imo risgo nga makaangkon sang heart problems kaangay sang fatal heart attack.
english: If you are in a toxic relationship, you are at increased risk of developing heart problems such as a fatal heart attack.

text: Magluwas sini, nagataas man ang imo blood sugar levels kag high blood pressure, nagapahina sang immune system kag madasig makabatyag sang kakapoy.
english: In addition, it also increases your blood sugar levels and high blood pressure, weakens the immune system and makes you feel tired more quickly.

text: Kun wala kana gina-respeto sang imo nga partner, kun lunsay kabutigan na lang ang iya ginahimo, kun kulang na siya sa pagpaninguha, kulang sang pagsalig, kulang sa komunikasyon, ginasakit kana pisikal kag emosyonal, panugyan ni Weinberger, tion na agud nga magbuya sa inyo nga relasyon.
english: If your partner doesn't respect you, if he's just lying, if he lacks effort, lacks trust, lacks communication, hurts you physically and emotionally, Weinberger advises, it's time to break up with your relationship.

text: Deserve mo ang isa ka healthy relationship sa diin duha kamo ang naga-respetuhanay kag gina-tratar ikaw nga may pagpalangga.
english: You deserve a healthy relationship where you both respect each other and treat you with love.

text: Nagpirma sang resolution ang 15 ka mga senador sa ginaduso nga resolusyon nga nagakondena sang mga pahayag sang embahada sang China batok sa pila ka mga opisyal sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas.
english: Fifteen senators signed a resolution on the proposed resolution condemning the Chinese embassy's statements against some Philippine government officials.

text: Ang mga statement nga ginbuy-an sang China amo ang ila balos sa kritisismo nga ginhimo sang mga Filipino officials sa mga agresibo nga aktwasyon sang Beijing sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The statements released by China were in response to criticism made by Filipino officials of Beijing's aggressive actions in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ang nagpirma sang draft resolution amo ang mga masunod: Senate President Vicente Sotto III, Panfilo Lacson, Juan Miguel Zubiri, Francis Pangilinan, Risa Hontiveros, Erwin Tulfo, Raffy Tulfo, Sherwin Gatchalian, Loren Legarda, JV Ejercito, Jinggoy Estrada, Bam Aquino, Lito Lapid, Camille Villar, kag Mark Villar.
english: The signatories of the draft resolution are as follows: Senate President Vicente Sotto III, Panfilo Lacson, Juan Miguel Zubiri, Francis Pangilinan, Risa Hontiveros, Erwin Tulfo, Raffy Tulfo, Sherwin Gatchalian, Loren Legarda, JV Ejercito, Jinggoy Estrada, Bam Aquino, Lito Villard, Camille Villard, Mark Villar and Camille Villar.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang mga senador sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga maghulag na kag maghimo sang diplomatiko nga mga tikang agud nga mapangapinan ang dignidad sang Pilipinas.
english: The senators also called on the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to act and take diplomatic steps to defend the dignity of the Philippines.

text: Una na nga nagpasaka sang diplomatic protests ang China batok kay Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Commodore Jay Tarriela bangud sa social media posts sini batok sa Chinese leaders.
english: China has already filed diplomatic protests against Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Commodore Jay Tarriela for his social media posts against Chinese leaders.

text:
Naka-post anay si Tarriela sang laragway ni Chinese President Xi Jinping nga may banner nga “Why China remains to be bully?”

Nagpanindugan naman si Tarriela nga nakabase ang iya mga pahayag sa matuod nga mga hitabo.
english:
Tarriela had previously posted a picture of Chinese President Xi Jinping with the banner “Why China remains to be bully?”

Tarriela insisted that his statements were based on true events.

text: Gilayon man nga nagpaguwa sang statement ang Malacanang nga nagatindog ini kaupod sa Filipino government officials nga gina-atake sang China bangud sang ila pagpamatok sa mga sala-sala nga naratibo sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Malacanang immediately issued a statement saying it stands with Filipino government officials who are being attacked by China for their opposition to false narratives in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Una naman nga nagkondena ang Department of National Defense kag ang National Security Council sa mga pahayag sang China.
english: The Department of National Defense and the National Security Council earlier condemned China's statements.

text: Ginpahalin na sang Sacramento Kings ang ila head coach nga si Mike Brown.
english: The Sacramento Kings have fired head coach Mike Brown.

text: Lima ka sunod-sunod nga kalutusan ang naangkon sang Kings sa hampang sa ila mismo homecourt kag nagapang-12 sila subong nga season sa Western Conference.
english: The Kings have lost five straight games on their own homecourt and are 12th this season in the Western Conference.

text: Base sa reports, si assistant coach Doug Christie ang magabulos apang sa interim basis lamang.
english: According to reports, assistant coach Doug Christie will take over but only on an interim basis.

text: 13-18 ang record sang Sacramento subong kag nalutos pa, 114-113, sa kamot sang Detroit Pistons sang nagligad nga Huwebes.
english: Sacramento is currently 13-18 and lost, 114-113, at the hands of the Detroit Pistons last Thursday.

text: Sang 2023, matandaan nga ginboto si Brown bilang NBA Coach of the Year matapos ginpangunahan sini ang Kings nga maka-abante sa Western Conference playoffs sa labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang 16 ka tuig.
english: In 2023, Brown was voted NBA Coach of the Year after leading the Kings to advance to the Western Conference playoffs for the first time in 16 years.

text: Sang Hunyo, nahatagan siya sang tatlo ka tuig nga contract extension.
english: In June, he was given a three-year contract extension.

text: Antes sa Kings, naka-coach siya sa Cleveland Cavaliers kag Los Angeles Lakers kag nangin assistant coach kay Steve Kerr sa Golden State Warriors.
english: Prior to the Kings, he coached with the Cleveland Cavaliers and Los Angeles Lakers and was an assistant coach to Steve Kerr with the Golden State Warriors.

text: Hindi bababa sa 657 katao ang nasawi at halos 1,000 ang nasugatan kaugnay ng malalakas na pag-ulan sa Pakistan mula noong Hunyo 26, ayon sa National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA).
english: At least 657 people have been killed and nearly 1,000 injured in connection with heavy rains in Pakistan since June 26, according to the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA).

text: Sa isang media briefing nitong Linggo, sinabi ng tagapagsalita ng NDMA na si Tayyab Shah na inaasahan pang magpapatuloy ang malalakas na pag-ulan hanggang Agosto 22, at may dalawa hanggang tatlong panibagong bugso ng monsoon rains silang inaasahan sa Setyembre.
english: In a media briefing on Sunday, NDMA spokesperson Tayyab Shah said the heavy rains are expected to continue until August 22, and two to three more monsoon rains are expected in September.

text: Ayon sa datos ng NDMA, kabilang sa mga nasawi ay 171 bata, 94 babae, at 392 lalaki.
english: According to NDMA data, among the victims were 171 children, 94 women, and 392 men.

text: Pinakamalubhang napinsala ang lalawigan ng Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, kung saan 390 katao ang namatay.
english: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa was the worst affected province, with 390 deaths.

text: Sinundan ito ng Punjab (164 patay), Sindh (28), Balochistan (20), Gilgit-Baltistan (32), Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (15), at Islamabad (8).
english: It was followed by Punjab (164 deaths), Sindh (28), Balochistan (20), Gilgit-Baltistan (32), Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (15), and Islamabad (8).

text: Habang sa Buner district, 84 katao ang nasawi sa flash floods dulot ng cloudburst, kabilang ang 21 miyembro ng isang pamilyang naghahanda sana para sa isang kasal.
english: Meanwhile, in Buner district, 84 people were affected by flash floods caused by cloudburst, including 21 members of a family who were preparing for a wedding.

text: Ayon pa kay PDMA Director General Asfandyar Khattak, may humigit-kumulang 150 katao pa ang nawawala sa mga lalawigan ng Buner at Shangla.
english: According to PDMA Director General Asfandyar Khattak, there are still about 150 people missing in Buner and Shangla provinces.

text: Kasalukuyang nagsasagawa sila ng rescue operations, at limang military helicopters narin ang ginagamit para sa operasyon.
english: They are currently conducting rescue operations, and five military helicopters are also being used for the operation.

text: Naglaan na rin ang pamahalaang panlalawigan ng PKR1.5 billion ($5,288,377) para sa relief operations.
english: The provincial government has also allocated PKR1.5 billion ($5,288,377) for relief operations.

text: Ipinadala na rin ang mga truck upang tumulong sa mga apektadong lugar, kabilang ang Buner, Swat, at Bajaur.
english: Trucks have also been sent to help the affected areas, including Buner, Swat, and Bajaur.

text: Samantala, narekober narin ang black box ng MI-17 rescue helicopter na bumagsak noong Agosto 15 sa Bajaur habang naghahatid ng relief goods kung saan lahat ng limang crew members ay nasawi.
english: Meanwhile, the black box of the MI-17 rescue helicopter that crashed on August 15 in Bajaur while delivering relief goods where all five crew members were killed was also recovered.

text: Iniutos naman ni Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif sa mga federal ministers nito na direktang pamunuan ang relief operations sa Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
english: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has ordered his federal ministers to directly lead the relief operations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

text: Isinasagawa na rin ang pamimigay ng food packs, tolda, at gamot sa ilalim ng PM’s Relief Package.
english: The distribution of food packs, tents, and medicines under the PM's Relief Package is also underway.

text: Ayon naman sa Department of Education ng Pakistan, 61 pampublikong paaralan ang hindi nag-ooperate, habang 414 pa ang bahagyang napinsala sa Khyber Pakhtunkhwa dahil sa malalakas na ulan at baha.
english: According to the Department of Education of Pakistan, 61 public schools are not operating, while 414 are still partially damaged in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa due to heavy rains and floods.

text: Pat-od nga nabatian mo na sa imo Lolo kag Lola ukon nabasahan sa libro ang mga istorya sang Tiempo Hapon diri sa Pilipinas.
english: You must have heard from your grandparents or read in books the stories of Tiempo Hapon here in the Philippines.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala?
english: But did you know?

text: Pila sa mga Hapon ang may nabilin nga kabataan diri sa Pilipinas kag subong lamang nga tuig nakatigayon nga nakabalik sa Japan.
english: Some of the Japanese have children left here in the Philippines and only this year were able to return to Japan.

text: Ini ang kaangay sang istorya sang 82-anyos nga Filipino-Japanese nga si Margarita Hiroko Koyama nga nabayaan sang iya amay nga Japanese national sang World War II sang 1945.
english: This is similar to the story of 82-year-old Filipino-Japanese Margarita Hiroko Koyama who was abandoned by her Japanese national father during World War II in 1945.

text: Taga-Digos, Davao Del Sur gid si Lola Margarita.
english: Lola Margarita is from Digos, Davao Del Sur.

text: Ang amay niya amo si Tomaho Koyama nga nag-abot sa Pilipinas antes pa man ang gyera kag nakapangasawa ini sang isa ka Pinay.
english: His father was Tomaho Koyama who came to the Philippines before the war and married a Filipina.

text: Apang pag-abot sang 1945 nga panahon sang World War II, ginbihag sang mga soldado sang Amerika si Tomaho kag ang iya nga mga anak antes pa man nag-surrender ang Japan sang Agusto 14, 1945.
english: But when World War II arrived in 1945, American soldiers captured Tomaho and her children before Japan surrendered on August 14, 1945.

text: Kasunod sadto, gin-deport si Tomaho sa Japan apang nabilin naman diri sa Pilipinas ang iya nga asawa kag mga anak.
english: Tomaho was subsequently deported to Japan but his wife and children remained in the Philippines.

text: Makaligad ang tatlo ka tuig, napatay man si Tomaho sa Fukuoka Prefecture sa Japan.
english: Three years later, Tomaho also died in Fukuoka Prefecture in Japan.

text: Natigayon naman nga na-restore ni Lola Margarita ang iya nga Japanese nationality sang 2017, nakakuha sang Japanese passport sang 2019, apang bangud sa posibilidad nga madagdagan sang Philippine Immigration sang daku nga penalidad kag iban pa sulukton, wala siya gihapon nakabalik sa Japan.
english: Lola Margarita managed to restore her Japanese nationality in 2017, obtained a Japanese passport in 2019, but due to the possibility of Philippine Immigration increasing the penalty and other charges, she still did not return to Japan.

text: Subong lamang nga Septyembre 2023, si Lola Margarita ang nangin labing-una nga war-displaced descendant sang Japanese migrant nga nakabalik sa Japan.
english: As recently as September 2023, Lola Margarita became the first war-displaced descendant of a Japanese migrant to return to Japan.

text: Ini kasunod sang negosasyon sang Philippine Government kag sang mga opisyal sang Japanese Embassy nga naga-waive sang multa sa mga kaangay ni Lola Margarita.
english: This follows negotiations between the Philippine Government and Japanese Embassy officials to waive fines for people like Lola Margarita.

text: Plano naman sang Lola nga magbisita sa pantyon sang iya amay.
english: The grandmother plans to visit her father's grave.

text: Ginpakigbahin sini nga wala gid niya na-imagine nga makatapak siya sa Japan, kag tubtub subong, wala pa sini nahibaluan kun ano ang iya una nga ihambal sa iya amay nga halos indi na niya madumduman ang itsura.
english: She shared that she never imagined she would set foot in Japan, and to this day, she doesn’t know what the first thing she would say to her father, whose appearance she barely remembers.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang mga opisyal sang embahada sang Japan diri sa Pilipinas nga magapadayon ang Japanese government sa pagbulig sa mga war-displaced descendants nga makabalik sa Japan.
english: Japanese embassy officials in the Philippines said the Japanese government will continue to help war-displaced descendants return to Japan.

english: Actress-entrepreneur Neri Naig is likely to spend Christmas and New Year at the Pasay City Jail Female Dormitory.

text: Apang sa mga tawo nga may depression, ang malipayon nga palibot nga makit-an sini ang makapalala pa sang ila nabatyagan.

text: Panugyan ni Dr Neil Jeyasingam, isa ka psychiatrist sa United Kingdom, kun ikaw ang may depression, importante nga mangin maayo ikaw sa imo kaugalingon ilabi na kun adlaw sang paskwa kag indi mo pagpahanugutan nga kan-on ikaw sang kasubo bangud sa imo kondisyon.
english: Dr Neil Jeyasingam, a psychiatrist in the United Kingdom, advises that if you are suffering from depression, it is important to be kind to yourself especially on Christmas day and not allow yourself to be consumed by sadness because of your condition.

text: Yari ang pila sa mga pamaagi agud nga malikawan ang kasubo sa adlaw sang paskwa.
english: Here are some of the ways to avoid sadness on Christmas day.

text: *Mag istorya ikaw sa imo pamilya ukon sa imo abyan kun ano ang imo nabatyagan.
english: *Talk to your family or friend about how you feel.

text: *Likawi ang alcohol bangud ini ang pa ang nagapalala sang imo ginabatyag.
english: *Avoid alcohol because it makes you feel worse.

text:
*Mangin positibo — isulat ang tatlo ka mga positibo nga butang sa imo kabuhi kada gab-i antes ikaw magtulog kag i-reflect ini kun ikaw ang magbugtaw sa aga kag;

*Indi pag i-isolate ang imo kaugalingon.
english:
*Be positive — write down three positive things in your life every night before you go to bed and reflect on them when you wake up in the morning and;

*Don't isolate yourself.

text: Kun may pagtililipon sa inyo pamilya sa adlaw sang paskwa, magguwa sa imo kwarto kag mag-upod sa pagselebrar.
english: If you have a family gathering on Christmas Day, get out of your room and join in the celebration.

english: PAOCC Executive Director, Undersecretary Gilbert Cruz said that only more than 100 POGOs are operating on a small-scale in the country after the declaration of total ban by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

english: From the large POGO hubs, Cruz said, most of these operators are already doing business in apartments, condominiums, including from their rooms in hotels or resorts.

text: Una na nga gin-rescue sang PAOCC ang 34 ka mga Indonesians sa gina-alegar POGO hub sa Pasay kag nadakpan ang isa ka Chinese woman nga si Liu Meng, duha ka wala makilala nga Chinese nationals, kag isa ka Malaysian.
english: Earlier, the PAOCC rescued 34 Indonesians from the alleged POGO hub in Pasay and arrested a Chinese woman named Liu Meng, two unidentified Chinese nationals, and a Malaysian.

text: ILOILO CITY – Normal lamang ang pag-angkon sang Presbyopia ukon farsightedness ilabi na kun naga-edad sang 40 anyos pataas.
english: ILOILO CITY – It is normal to have presbyopia or farsightedness especially if you are 40 years old and above.

text: Sa pagpaathag ni Dr. Irene Peliño, Board of Examiner in Optometry sang Professional Regulation Commission kag miyembro sang Integrated Philippine Association of Optometrists, Inc., ang Presbyopia ang tuga sang pagkadula sang elasticity sang lens sa mata rason nga ang makita lamang amo ang mga butang nga yara sa malayo.
english: In the explanation of Dr. Irene Peliño, Board of Examiner in Optometry of the Professional Regulation Commission and member of the Integrated Philippine Association of Optometrists, Inc., said Presbyopia is caused by the loss of elasticity of the lens in the eye causing only objects that are far away to be seen.

text: Suno kay Dr. Peliño, may yara sang prescribed lens nga ginahatag sa mga pasyente nga may Presbyopia kag ang nagakaigo nga eye grade ang mahibalu-an lamang paagi sa chek-up.
english: According to Dr. Peliño said there are prescribed lenses that are given to patients with Presbyopia and the appropriate eye grade can only be determined through a check-up.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dr. Peliño nga ang prescribed lens ang nagapatin-aw sang panan-awan sang mga may Presbyopia kag wala sini ginapadako ang mga letra ukon butang nga dapat makita sang mata.
english: He said Dr. Peliño said the prescribed lens clarifies the vision of those with presbyopia and does not magnify letters or objects that should be visible to the eye.

text: Masami nga sintomas sang Presbyopia amo ang pagsakit sang ulo tuga sang buron nga panan-awan kag agud nga makita, ginapalayo sang pasyente ang ginabasa agud nga mangin maathag ang mga letra.
english: A common symptom of Presbyopia is a headache caused by blurred vision and in order to see, the patient moves the reading away so that the letters are clear.

text: Ang kabaliskaran naman sang Presbyopia amo ang Myopia ukon nearsightedness kun sa diin ang mga malapit lang nga butang ang makita.
english: The opposite of presbyopia is myopia or nearsightedness where only near objects are seen.

text: Samtang, naga-umpisa na ang pagbaton sang indigent patients nga interesado nga mangin benepisyaryo sang proyekto nga “Panan-awan mo, Amligan ko” sang Integrated Philippine Association of Optometrists, Inc.
english: Meanwhile, the acceptance of indigent patients who are interested in becoming beneficiaries of the project “Pananwanwan mo, Amligan ko” of the Integrated Philippine Association of Optometrists, Inc.

text: Suno kay Dr. Peliño, ang ila grupo ang masami nga nagapakigbahin sa Bombo Medico sang Bombo Radyo Philippines apang bangud sa pandemya, wala ini nadayon subong nga tuig.
english: According to Dr. Peliño said their group often participates in Bombo Medico of Bombo Radyo Philippines but due to the pandemic, it was not held this year.

text: May kaangtanan diri, ang mga qualified benificiaries ang mahimo nga makapakig-angot sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo para sa screening.
english: In this regard, qualified beneficiaries can contact Bombo Radyo Iloilo for screening.

text: Lakip sa qualifications amo nga dapat naga-edad sang 40 anyos pataas, may deperensya sa mata kag dapat nga indigent.
english: The qualifications include being 40 years of age or older, visually impaired and indigent.

text: Ang mga kwalipikado nga benipisyaryo ang makabaton sang libre nga check-up kag eyeglasses.
english: Eligible beneficiaries will receive free check-ups and eyeglasses.

text: Nagnubo sang 38.9% ang approved foreign investments sa Pilipinas sang nagligad nga tuig sa P543.62 billion, pinakamataas nga pagnubo sa sulod sang apat ka tuig.
english: Approved foreign investments in the Philippines fell 38.9% last year to P543.62 billion, the highest decline in four years.

text: Ang una nga datos gikan sa Philippine Statistics Authority nagapakita nga ang balor sang foreign commitments nga gin-aprubahan sang mga ahensya sa investment promotion agencies (IPAs) sang pungsod sang 2024 mas manubo sa P889.24 billion sang 2023.
english: Preliminary data from the Philippine Statistics Authority shows that the value of foreign commitments approved by agencies in the country’s investment promotion agencies (IPAs) in 2024 was lower than P889.24 billion in 2023.

text: Ginakabig nga ang tuigan nga pagnubo sang mga foreign investments amo ang pinaka-lowest halin sa 71.3% nga pagnubo nga narekord sang 2020.
english: It is considered that the annual decline in foreign investments is the lowest since the 71.3% decline recorded in 2020.

text: Sa tatlo ka bulan tubtob Disyembre, ang mga pledges naglab-ot sa P57.70 billion, nga nagnubo sang 85.4% gikan sa P394.46 billion sa amo man nga panahon sang 2023.
english: In the three months to December, pledges amounted to P57.70 billion, down 85.4% from P394.46 billion in the same period in 2023.

text: Amo ini ang pinakamataas nga pagnubo sa sulod sang 26 ka tuig ukon halin sa 94.5% nga pagnubo sang ikatlo nga quarter sang 1998.
english: This was the steepest decline in 26 years or since a 94.5% decline in the third quarter of 1998.

text: Sa balor, ini ang pinakamanubo halin sang P27.46 billio sa ikatlo nga quarter sang 2023.
english: By value, this is the lowest since P27.46 billion in the third quarter of 2023.

text: Nagdala ini sang gross domestic product (GDP) sang pungsod sa 5.6% sang 2024, sa idalom sang revised nga 6-6.5% nga target sang gobyerno.
english: This brought the country’s gross domestic product (GDP) to 5.6% by 2024, below the government’s revised 6-6.5% target.

text: Mahigit 300 katao ang nasawi sa Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province sa hilagang-kanlurang bahagi ng Pakistan matapos ang dalawang araw ng matinding pag-ulan at flash floods, ayon sa mga lokal na opisyal nitong Linggo (araw sa Pilipinas), Agosto 17.
english: More than 300 people were stranded in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province in northwestern Pakistan after two days of heavy rains and flash floods, local officials said on Sunday (Philippine Day), August 17.

text: Ayon sa National Disaster Management Authority, karamihan sa mga nasawi ay nalibing matapos matabunan ang kanilang mga bahay nang gumuhong lupa, at ang ilan ay nasawi matapos tamaan ng kidlat.
english: According to the National Disaster Management Authority, most of the victims were buried after their houses were covered by landslides, and some were buried after being struck by lightning.

text: Mahigit 137 katao rin ang naiulat na sugatan.
english: More than 137 people were also reported injured.

text: Isa sa mga residente ang nagsabing parang end of the world ang naramdaman habang matapos ang malalakas na agos ng baha.
english: One of the residents said it felt like the end of the world after the strong flood.

text: Pinakamalubhang tinamaan ang Buner district, kung saan 184 ang nasawi at matindidng pinsala sa inprastruktura, pananim, at pagkasira ng mga punong-kahoy.
english: Buner district was the worst affected, with 184 people affected and severe damage to infrastructure, crops, and destruction of trees.

text: Nagpapatuloy naman ang paghahanap sa mga nawawala, habang marami ang nananatiling stranded dahil sa baha, kabilang ang mga kababaihan at bata.
english: The search for the missing continues, while many remain stranded due to the floods, including women and children.

text: Samantala ang malawakang pag-ulan ay bahagi ng magang pagsisimula ng monsoon season ng bansa, na ayon sa mga opisyal ay magtatagal ng isang linggo.
english: Meanwhile, the widespread rains are part of the slow start to the country's monsoon season, which officials say will last for a week.

text: Matinding pinsala rin ang naitala sa mga karatig-bansa gaya ng India at Nepal.
english: Heavy damage was also recorded in neighboring countries such as India and Nepal.

text: ENGLAND – Ang honey nga makita sa balayan sang buyog ang ginapanugyan nga bulong sa ubo.
english: ENGLAND – Honey found in beehives is recommended as a cough remedy.

text: Suno sa pagtuon nga ginpatigayon sang National Institute for Health and Care Excellence kag sang Public Health England nga ang honey ang may yara sang bacteria nga makatunaw sang throat inflamation.
english: According to a study conducted by the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence and Public Health England, honey contains bacteria that can dissolve throat inflammation.

text: Sa pagpaathag ni Dr. Susan Hopkins, deputy director sang Public Health England, mas maayo nga isamo sa mainit nga tubig ang honey kag imnon sang amat-amat.
english: In the explanation of Dr. Susan Hopkins, deputy director of Public Health England, says it is best to mix honey with warm water and drink it slowly.

text: Suno kay Hopkins, ang pag-inom sini ang kasubong sa epekto sang lemon kag luy-a nga ginbutang sa tubig.
english: According to Hopkins, drinking it is similar to the effect of lemon and ginger in water.

text: Sa pihak sini, daku nga pagpanghangkat para sa medical experts nga bulongon sa natural nga paagi ang ubo apang mahimo maglala pa ang ginabatyag bangud sa mga ginaresita nga antibiotics kag mga inflamatory medicines.
english: However, it is a big challenge for medical experts to treat cough naturally but it can get worse due to prescribed antibiotics and inflammatory medicines.

text: Eksklusibo nga napakig-angutan sang Bombo Radyo ang pamilya sang isa ka Ilonggo Seaman nga si Jujerick Layer nga isa ka crew sa MV Trisha Kerstin 3 nga amo ang naglugdang nga roro vessel sa bahin sang baybayon sang Basilan.
english: Bombo Radyo exclusively contacted the family of an Ilonggo seaman, Jujerick Layer, a crew member of MV Trisha Kerstin 3, the roro vessel that sank off the coast of Basilan.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jose Pendioday, Lolo sang nasambit nga survivor, iya ginpahayag nga tuman gid ang ila nga kakulba sang ila nga nabalitaan nga naglugdang ang ginsakyan nga barko sang iya nga apo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jose Pendioday, grandfather of the survivor, said they were shocked when they heard that his grandson's ship sank.

text: Suno kay Pendioday, wala siya makakaun sang mayo sa pagpaminsar kun ano na ang natabo sa iya apo.
english: According to Pendioday, he could not eat well thinking about what happened to his grandson.

text: Dako man ang iya nga pagpasalamat sa Bombo Radyo bangud nga diri nila nakit-an nga nakasurvive si Jujerick .
english: He also expressed his gratitude to Bombo Radyo for finding Jujerick survived.

text: Matapos man nila nga mabalitaan nga safe ang iya apo, naisturya naman nila ini kag ginsaysay sini kun ano ang natabo sa iya.
english: After they heard that his grandson was safe, they talked to him and he told them what had happened to him.

text: Nagpahayag man si Jujerick sa iya lolo nga isa man sa kaupod sini nga Ilonggo kag kaangay man iya nga apprentice ang nagtaliwan sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: Jujerick also told his grandfather that one of his fellow Ilonggos and fellow apprentice died in the incident.

text: Apang wala naman sang iban pa nga detalye nga ginsaysay ang Ilonggo survivor bangud man nga nagarecover pa ini sa natabo sa ila barko.
english: However, the Ilonggo survivor did not provide any other details as he was still recovering from the incident on their ship.

text: Samtang, nagpaabot naman sang mensahe ang lolo ni Jujerick sa iya nga suno sa iya nga nagalain ang buot sini sa natabo sa apo apang iya man ini istoryahon kun mangin okay na ang kahimtangan sini.

Sang nagdaog si Usyk, nagselebrar ini paagi sa pag-uyat sang sabre nga iya ni Ivan Mazepa nga isa ka baganihan sang Ukrainian nationalism nga nagpakig-away batok sa Russian control sang early 1700s.
english:
FOR UKRAINE

When Usyk won, he celebrated by wielding a saber that belonged to Ivan Mazepa a hero of Ukrainian nationalism who fought against Russian control in the early 1700s.

text: Matandaan nga nakabutang sa record ni Usyk nga naka-serbe man ini bilang soldado sa Ukraine antes ang Russian invasion sa Kyiv halos tatlo ka tuig na ang nagligad.

text: Gintugyan na sa chairperson sang Committee on Communication and Public Information sa Iloilo City Council kun ano ang mangin desisyon sini kaangot sa wala pa na-reconcile nga mga probisyon sa duha ka ordinansa nga ginduso kaangot sa Freedom of Information (FOI).
english: The chairperson of the Committee on Communication and Public Information in the Iloilo City Council has been left to decide on the unreconciled provisions of the two ordinances proposed on Freedom of Information (FOI).

text: Ini matapos nga nagtakop na ang ginpatigayon nga committee hearing agud nga maplastar ang halos pareho lang nga ordinansa nga ginduso nanday Councilor Nene Dela Llana kag Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog.
english: This is after the committee hearing to put forward the almost identical ordinance proposed by Councilor Nene Dela Llana and Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dela Llana, iya ginpahayag nga kun makahimo na sang committee report ang committee chairperson nga si Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, maga-debate na sila ni Mabilog sa sesyon sang konseho.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dela Llana said that once the committee report is made, the committee chairperson, Councilor Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, he and Mabilog will debate in the council session.

text: Pahayag pa ni Dela Llana, duha ka beses nga gin-amyendaran ni Mabilog ang iya nga ginaproponer nga ordinansa, gani nga pag-abot sa committee hearing, halos pareho na sila kag wala na sila ginbudlayan pa.
english: Dela Llana said Mabilog amended his proposed ordinance twice, so that when it came to the committee hearing, they were almost the same and did not have any difficulty.

text: Lakip sa gintumod sini nga kinalain sa ila nga ordinansa amo ang iya ginaduso nga FOI desk agud nga mas plastado kag dira na magkadto ang mga pumuluyo kag magpamangkot kaangot sa ila kinahanglan nga impormasyon.
english: Among the differences he pointed out in their ordinance is his proposed FOI desk so that it will be more located and where the residents can go and ask questions about their needed information.

text: Ginaduso man ni Dela Llana nga regular employee ang mangin head sang FOI desk bangud sensitibo ang mga impormasyon nga uyatan sini, kag agud nga may salabton man ini pananglitan may mga sala.
english: Dela Llana also proposed that a regular employee be the head of the FOI desk because the information it handles is sensitive, and so that it will be held accountable in case of errors.

text: “Councilor Cabaluna will deliver his committee report, and then i-refer back niya na sa amon, and then we can debate on the floor, and then hopefully mahatagan naton ang aton syudad sang best version sang Freedom of Information.
english: “Councilor Cabaluna will deliver his committee report, and then he will refer back to us, and then we can debate on the floor, and then hopefully we can give our city the best version of Freedom of Information.

text: Everybody wins, tanan daog,” pahayag sang konsehal.
english: Everybody wins, everyone wins,” the councilor said.

text: “I will leave it to his sound judgment kag sa wisdom niya [ni Councilor Cabaluna], kag once nga ibalik ya sa amon, we will debate,” dugang pa ni Dela Llana.
english: “I will leave it to his sound judgment and his [Councilor Cabaluna's] wisdom, and once he returns it to us, we will debate,” Dela Llana added.

text: Matandaan nga sang Nobyembre 27, 2025 sang una nga ginpatigayon ang hearing agud diskusyunan ang duha ka magkatuhay nga ordinansa sang duha ka nasambit nga konsehal.
english: It can be recalled that on November 27, 2025, the first hearing was held to discuss the two different ordinances of the two councilors.

text: Sa baylo nga lunsay selebrasyon ang tutukan sang Espanya matapos ang maragtason nga kadalag-an sa FIFA Women’s World Cup, nabutang pa sa kontrobersiya ang pangalan sang football federation president sa pungsod.
english: Instead of focusing on celebrations after Spain's historic FIFA Women's World Cup victory, the name of the country's football federation president is still in controversy.

text: Ini bangud nakit-an gid sang publiko kun paano sini gulpi nga ginhalukan sa bibig ang midfielder nga si Jenni Hermoso sang tion nga naga-selebrar ang tanan bangud nalutos sang Espanya ang England sa Final match.
english: This is because the public saw how he suddenly kissed midfielder Jenni Hermoso on the lips while everyone was celebrating because Spain defeated England in the final match.

text: Matapos nga ginpasuksok sang football federation chief nga si Luis Rubiales ang gold medal sa mga myembro sang Spanish team, ginpanghakos sini ang mga players apang pag-abot kay Jenni, wala gid ini nakapugong kag nahalukan niya ini.
english: After football federation chief Luis Rubiales presented the gold medal to the members of the Spanish team, he hugged the players but when it came to Jenni, he couldn't help but kiss her.

text: Sa locker room naman sang players, nagpanugid si Jenni nga wala siya nanamian sa amo nga halok; apang sang nagpaguwa na sang formal nga statement, ginsiling sini nga wala lang sa iya ang amo nga insidente bangud bunga ini sang tuman nga selebrasyon sang kada isa kag isa ini ka “natural gesture”.
english: In the players' locker room, Jenni said she didn't like the kiss; but when he issued a formal statement, he said that he was not alone in the incident because it was the result of the celebration of each other and it was a “natural gesture”.

text: Nagpangayo naman sang pasaylo ang football chief sa iya nga sala kag gin-ako ang iya nga ginhimo.
english: The football chief apologized for his mistake and admitted his actions.

text: “I will learn from this and understand that when you are president of an institution as important as the Federation especially in ceremonies and in this type of matters, you have to be more careful,” pahayag sang football chief.
english: “I will learn from this and understand that when you are president of an institution as important as the Federation especially in ceremonies and in this type of matters, you have to be more careful,” stated the football chief.

text: Mangin ang mga ministers sang gobyerno kag ang media commentators sa Espanya ang nagpakamalaot sa amo nga gesture.
english: Even government ministers and media commentators in Spain condemned the gesture.

text: Nagmandu man si acting Culture and Sports Minister Miquel Iceta kay Rubiales nga maghatag sang paathag kasunod sang amo nga insidente nga iya gintawag nga “unacceptable”.
english: Acting Culture and Sports Minister Miquel Iceta also ordered Rubiales to give an explanation following the incident which he called “unacceptable”.

text: Nahibaluan nga tuman ka daku nga topiko ang gender issues sa Espanya.
english: It is known that gender issues are a very big topic in Spain.

text: Suno kay acting Gender Equality Minister Irene Montero, ang non-consensual kiss ukon ang gulpi-gulpi lang nga halok nga wala ginapangayo ukon gintugtan, ang makabig nga isa ka sex violence nga adlaw-adlaw ginasuprer sang mga kababainhan apang daw wala lang sa gihapon nahatagan sang nagakaigu nga igtalupangod.
english: According to acting Gender Equality Minister Irene Montero, non-consensual kiss or a sudden kiss that is not requested or allowed, is considered a sex violence that women suffer every day but still does not seem to be given due attention.

text: Masami ka bala nga nagahuragok?
english: Do you often hug?

text: Ukon natak-an kana bala sa magahod nga huragok sang upod mo sa pagtulog?
english: Or are you tired of your roommate's noisy snoring?

text: Suno kay Dr. Virginia de los Reyes, sleep specialist sa Lung Center of the Philippines , apisar ang paghuragok ang warning sign na sang obstructive sleep apnea, indi tanan nga nagahuragok ang may yara sang sleep apnea kag indi tanan nga may sleep apnea ang nagahuragok.
english: According to Dr. Virginia de los Reyes, sleep specialist at the Lung Center of the Philippines, said that although snoring is a warning sign of obstructive sleep apnea, not everyone who snores has sleep apnea and not everyone who has sleep apnea snores.

text: Gani, dapat nga bantayan ang paghuragok kag obstructive sleep apnea bangud delikado ini sa ikaayong lawas bangud mahimo ini nga mangin bunga sang heart failure, heart attack, high blood pressure, stroke, neurocognitive impairment kag aksidente nga tuga sang pagkatuyo.
english: Therefore, snoring and obstructive sleep apnea should be monitored as they are dangerous to health because they can lead to heart failure, heart attack, high blood pressure, stroke, neurocognitive impairment and accidents caused by drowsiness.

text: Ang obstructive sleep apnea ang nangin kabangdanan sang liwat-liwat nga pag-untat kag pag-umpisa sang pagginhawa sa pagtulog.
english: Obstructive sleep apnea causes repeated stops and starts of breathing during sleep.

text: Pahayag niya, ini ang nagakaapekto sa kadam-an nga mga kalalakihan apang may mga kababaihan nga yara sa menopausal kag postmenopausal period ang may mataas man nga peligro.
english: He said it affects mostly men but there are women in the menopausal and postmenopausal period who are also at high risk.

text: Ini ang naka-apekto sa tanan nga tawo ano man nga edad lakip na ang mga bata.
english: It has affected all people of any age including children.

text: 10 ka adlaw pa lang ang “Hello, Love, Again” sa mga sinehan apang naagaw na sini ang titulo nga highest grossing Filipino film of all time.
english: “Hello, Love, Again” has only been in theaters for 10 days but it has already won the title of highest grossing Filipino film of all time.

text:
Ini nga pelikula kun sa diin bida sanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Alden Richards ang naka-tipon na sang P930-million halin sa worldwide theatrical sales as of November 22, 7 p.m.

Ini nga box office title ang gin-uyatan anay sang 2023 Metro Manila Film Festival entry nga “Rewind” sang mag-asawa nga sanday Dingdong Dantes kag Marian Rivera.
english:
The film starring Kathryn Bernardo and Alden Richards has grossed P930-million from worldwide theatrical sales as of November 22, 7 p.m.

This box office title was previously held by the 2023 Metro Manila Film Festival entry “Rewind” by duo Dingdong Dantes and Marian Rivera.

text: Ang “Rewind” amo ang first Filipino film nga nakakolekta sang masobra P900 million sa worldwide box office kag kabug-usan nga nakakuha sang P924 million sa bug-os nga theatrical run.
english: “Rewind” is the first Filipino film to collect more than P900 million at the worldwide box office and a total of P924 million in its entire theatrical run.

text: Apang sanday Kath kag Alden na subong ang bag-o nga box-office record holders nga yara subong sa United States agud magtambong sa 10th Asian World Film Festival sa Culver City, California kaupod ang iban nga cast members.
english: But Kath and Alden are now the new box-office record holders who are currently in the United States to attend the 10th Asian World Film Festival in Culver City, California with other cast members.

text: Ginalantaw nga mas magadaku pa ang income bangud ginapakita ang pelikula sa masobra 1,000 cinemas sa kalibutan lakip na sa US, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Saipan, kag Guam kag buksan man sa Asian countries (outside the Philippines) kag mga teritoryo sa masunod nga semana.
english: The film is expected to grow even more as the film is being shown in more than 1,000 cinemas worldwide including in the US, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Saipan, and Guam and will also open in Asian countries (outside the Philippines) and territories next week.

text:
Ginhimo ang “Hello, Love, Again” sa idalom sang direksyon ni Cathy Garcia-Sampana kag amo ang sequel sa 2019 blockbuster movie nga “Hello, Love, Goodbye.”

Antes ini nga movie, isa lang ka pelikula sa masobra 40 local mainstream films sa Pilipinas nga ginpakita sang 2024 ang may mayo nga record sa box office kag ini amo ang Un/Happy for You sang mag-ex nga sanday Joshua Garcia kag Julia Barreto nga naka-P390 million sa ticket sales as of September 2.
english:
“Hello, Love, Again” was produced under the direction of Cathy Garcia-Sampana and is the sequel to the 2019 blockbuster movie “Hello, Love, Goodbye.”

Before this movie, only one film out of more than 40 local mainstream films in the Philippines shown in 2024 had a good record at the box office and that was Un/Happy for You by exes Joshua Garcia and Julia Barreto which made P390 million in ticket sales as of September 2.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon sang otoridad nga ang pagkalubong sa utang ang rason kun ngaa nahimo sang isa ka amay nga i-hostage ang duwa ka anak kag patyon ang isa sa ila.
english: Authorities' investigation revealed that debt was the reason why a father took his two sons hostage and killed one of them.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Dasmariñas, Cavite matapos mag-amok ang nasambit nga amay nga may depresyon bangud sa utang.
english: The incident occurred in Dasmariñas, Cavite after the father, who was depressed due to debt, went on a rampage.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa man ka babaye nga boarder sa apartment kun sa diin nagaistar ang suspek kag kabataan sini ang ginhimo man niya nga bihag.
english: It was learned that a female boarder in the apartment where the suspect lives and her children were also taken hostage by him.

text: Matapos ang negosasyon,napilitan nga magsulod ang mga pulis sang nabatian nila ang paghilibion sang kabataan nga kaangay nga ginabuno sang suspek.
english: After the negotiations, the police were forced to enter when they heard the children crying as if they were being stabbed by the suspect.

text: Sang hana nga atakehon sang suspek ang mga pulis, didto na siya gintiro kag napatay.
english: When the suspect tried to attack the police, he was shot and killed.

text: Nadala pa ang kabataan sa ospital apang ginbawian sang kabuhi ang lima ka tuig nga bata samtang nakaluwas naman ang pito ka tuig nga magulang sang napatay.
english: The children were rushed to the hospital but the five-year-old died while the seven-year-old brother of the deceased survived.

text: Sa subong, pareho nga nahaya ang suspek kag ang iya bata nga siya mismo ang nagpatay.
english: Now, both the suspect and his son are ashamed that he killed himself.

text: Suno naman sa asawa, antes ang trahedya, pila ka adlaw nga wala nagakaon ang iya bana kag indi mapahamtang bangud sa problema sa utang.
english: According to the wife, before the tragedy, her husband had not eaten for several days and was unable to settle down due to debt problems.

text: Ginalantaw nga sa Marso pa ipatuman sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) para sa karne sang baboy.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is expected to implement the maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) for pork in March.

text: Santo sa latest monitoring sang ahensya, nagatupa sa P380 tubtub sa P480 per kilo ang presyo sang liempo samtang yara naman sa P350 tubtub sa P420 ang presyo sang kada kilo sang kasim ukon pork ham.
english: According to the agency's latest monitoring, the price of liempo is falling at P380 to P480 per kilo while the price of kasim or pork ham is at P350 to P420 per kilo.

text: Sang naglibot ang DA kag ang Department of Trade and Industry on Wednesday, ginpamangkot ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: When the DA and the Department of Trade and Industry toured on Wednesday, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. asked.

text: ang retailers kun ngaa mataas gihapon ang presyo.
english: the retailers why the price is still high.

text: Paathag nila, may ahente pa sila nga kinahanglan bayaran, gasolina, mga tawo, kag pag-ihaw magluwas pa sa farmgate price.
english: They explained that they still have an agent to pay, gasoline, people, and slaughter besides the farmgate price.

text: Suno kay Laurel, tun-an sang maayo ang value chain para nga maanalisar gid sang DA.
english: Laurel said the value chain will be studied carefully so that the DA can analyze it.

text: Nagatipon pa subong ang ahensya sang dugang nga impormasyon apang suno sa tiglikom, sigurado nga dayunon nila ang implementasyon sang maximum suggested retail price.
english: The agency is still gathering more information but the secretary said they are sure to continue the implementation of the maximum suggested retail price.

text: Ginalauman nga makumpleto ang ila nga data-gathering antes magtakop ang Pebrero.
english: Their data-gathering is expected to be completed before the end of February.

text: Una naman nga ginpasalig sang DA nga bisan mataas ang presyo sang karne sang baboy, bastante ang suplay sini diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Earlier, the DA assured that despite the high price of pork, there is sufficient supply of pork in the Philippines.

text: Wala sang agreement nga ceasefire sa Ukraine matapos ang tatlo ka oras nga meeting nanday US President Donald Trump kag Russian President Vladimir Putin sa Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson sa Alaska.
english: There was no ceasefire agreement in Ukraine after a three-hour meeting between US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Alaska.

text:
Apang, pareho nga gintawag nga “extremely productive” ang summit, ginsiling ni Trump sa media: “There’s no deal until there’s a deal.”

Nag-warning man ini sang mabug-at nga economic sanctions ang Russia kun padayon nga indi magpati si Putin sa ceasefire.
english:
However, both called the summit “extremely productive,” Trump told the media: “There’s no deal until there’s a deal.”

He also warned of heavy economic sanctions against Russia if Putin continues to ignore the ceasefire.

text: Wala gin-imbitar sa sinapol si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, bagay na ginakabalak-an sang mga kaalyado sa Europa.

text: “Tayo ay sumulat upang isumite ang 677 pang pangalan na nakalagay sa acknowldgement receipts kung saan tayo po ay binigyan ng tugon ng Philippine Statistics Authority dated December 8, 2024.

text: Pamatud-an sang Pilipinas sa atubang sang iban nga mga pungsod nga nakahimo na ini sang record sa patag sang gymnastics kag masanag pa ang puturo sang nasyon para sa sini nga sport event.
english: The Philippines will prove to other countries that it has already set a record in the field of gymnastics and the future of the country is still bright for this sporting event.

text: Suno sa Gymnastics of the Philippines (GAP), nadag-an sang Pilipinas ang bidding sa pag-host sang 2025 Junior World Artistic Gymnastics Championships.
english: According to Gymnastics of the Philippines (GAP), the Philippines won the bid to host the 2025 Junior World Artistic Gymnastics Championships.

text: Patigayunon ini sa Hulyo 12-21 sa masunod nga tuig kun sa diin 93 ka mga nasyon ang magapasakop.
english: It will be held on July 12-21 next year with 93 countries participating.

text: Suno kay GAP president Cynthia Carrion, wala pa sang natumod nga official venue.
english: According to GAP president Cynthia Carrion, no official venue has been identified.

text: Ginalauman na nga mas makilala diri nga event kag mas makapakita sang maayo nga performance si Karl Eldrew nga manghod sang two-time Olympic gold medalist nga si Carlos Yulo.
english: Karl Eldrew, the younger brother of two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo, is expected to be more recognized at this event and show a better performance.

text: Suno kay Carrion, ginalantaw nila nga mabulsa ni Eldrew ang gold medal.
english: Carrion said they expect Eldrew to pocket the gold medal.

text: Magluwas diri, ginapreparahan na sang Pilipinas ang pagpasakop sa 2028 Los Angeles Olympics kun sa diin ginalauman nga matupungan kun indi man malapawan ang duha ka gold medals ni Caloy sa artistic gymnastics.
english: In addition, the Philippines is preparing to participate in the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics where it is expected to match if not surpass Caloy's two gold medals in artistic gymnastics.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Carrion nga nagalaum siya nga duha ka mga Yulo ang maga-compete sa Los Angeles sa amo nga tuig.
english: Carrion also said he hopes two Yulos will compete in Los Angeles that year.

text: Antes ang Olympiada, mangin masako sa 2025 si Caloy ilabi na sa World Championship, World Cup, Southeast Asian Games kag Asian Championships magluwas pa sa pagkadto sa training camps sa United States, Spain, Korea, Japan, Australia kag sa United Kingdom.
english: Before the Olympiad, Caloy will be busy in 2025 especially in the World Championship, World Cup, Southeast Asian Games and Asian Championships besides going to training camps in the United States, Spain, Korea, Japan, Australia and the United Kingdom.

text: Nalakip ang lima ka mga hepe sa syudad sang Iloilo sa 46 ka mga station commander sa Western Visayas nga gin-relieve epektibo subong nga adlaw, Enero 30.
english: Five Iloilo City chiefs are among the 46 station commanders in Western Visayas who were relieved effective today, January 30.

text:
Sandig sa Issuance of Orders for Reassignment kag Resolution 2026-01 sang nagligad Enero 27, 2026, nalakip sa lista ang mga masunod:

Magluwas sa lima halin sa Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), may 11 naman nga gikan sa Antique Police Provincial Office (PPO), anum ang halin sa Aklan PPO, 10 ang halin sa Capiz PPO, isa sa Guimaras PPO, kag 13 ang halin sa Iloilo PPO.
english:
Pursuant to the Issuance of Orders for Reassignment and Resolution 2026-01 last January 27, 2026, the list includes the following:

Besides the five from the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO), there are 11 from the Antique Police Provincial Office (PPO), six from the Aklan PPO, 10 from the Capiz PPO, one from the Guimaras PPO, and 13 from the Iloilo PPO.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Lailyn Sencil, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office (PRO) VI, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga reassignment ang kabahin sang regular administrative process ukon ang rotation sang commanders nga nakaserbe na sang isa tubtub duha ka tuig ukon mas malawig pa bilang hepe.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Lailyn Sencil, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office (PRO) VI, said the reassignment is part of the regular administrative process or the rotation of commanders who have served one to two years or longer as chiefs.

text: Gin-deliberate kag ginproseso ini suno sa iya paagi sa Second Level Officers Placement Board agud masigurado ang transparency, objectivity, kag istrikto nga pagsunod sa existing nga mga patakaran kag guidelines sang PNP.
english: He said it was deliberated and processed through the Second Level Officers Placement Board to ensure transparency, objectivity, and strict compliance with the existing rules and guidelines of the PNP.

text: Ang pag-relieve kag pag-reassign sa ila ang nakasandig sa naka-establisar nga criteria suno sa PNP nga nagalakip sang kadugayon sang pagtinir sa posisyon sini subong, cumulative tenure of duty sang at least anum ka tuig, kag merit- kag performance-based nga mga konsiderasyon.
english: The relief and reassignment of them is based on established criteria, according to the PNP, which include length of service in their current positions, cumulative tenure of duty of at least six years, and merit- and performance-based considerations.

text: Ginklaro PRO VI opisina nga kinaandan ini nga ginahimo sang PNP kag wala sang na-involve nga kapaltahan.
english: PRO VI office clarified that this is normal practice of the PNP and there was no fault involved.

text: Wala pa ginpatpat kun sa diin ma-assign ang ginpang-relieve nga mga hepe, apang sandig sa inisyal nga pahayag sang opisina, may yara sang iga-assign sa regional headquarters.#
english: It is not yet clear where the relieved chiefs will be assigned, but according to the initial statement of the office, some will be assigned to regional headquarters.

text: Patay gid ang isa ka manunudlo matapos nabungguan samtang nagatabok sa pedestrian lane sa Barangay Lanao, Kidapawan City.
english: A teacher was killed after being hit while crossing the pedestrian lane in Barangay Lanao, Kidapawan City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jeconi Joice Paler, 33-anyos, manunudlo sa USM-KCC, kag residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Jeconi Joice Paler, 33, a teacher at USM-KCC, and a resident of the said barangay.

english: The victim was about to buy milk for her child when she was hit by a motorcycle driven by Christian Curato, 23, also a resident of the same city.

text: Nag-angkon ini sang mga pilas sa ulo kag lawas kag nadala pa sa ospital kag samtang yara sa Intensive Care Unit (ICU), ginbawian ini sang kabuhi.
english: He sustained head and body injuries and was rushed to the hospital and died while in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

text: Gin-ako ni Warriors superstar Stephen Curry kun daw ano ka makahuluya ang 51-puntos nga abanse nga gintambak sang Memphis Grizzlies batok sa pangayaw nga Golden State sa ila hampang subong nga regular season, 144-93.
english: Warriors superstar Stephen Curry admitted how embarrassing the 51-point lead the Memphis Grizzlies piled up against host Golden State in their regular season game, 144-93, was.

text: Sa 24 minutos nga playing time, dos puntos gid lamang ang nahimo ni Curry nga amo ang pinakamanubo sini nga na-skor sa isa ka hampang sa iya 16-anyos nga karera sa liga.
english: In 24 minutes of playing time, Curry scored just two points, the lowest he has scored in a game in his 16-year career in the league.

text: Gindugangan ini sang three rebounds, one assist, one steal kag one block.
english: That was supplemented by three rebounds, one assist, one steal and one block.

text: Ang iya teammate nga si Draymond Green ang wala gid naka-puntos, wala sang rebound, wala sang block, wala sang assist, kag may isa gid lamang ka steal sa sulod sang 19 minutos nga paghampang.
english: His teammate Draymond Green had zero points, no rebounds, no blocks, no assists, and only one steal in 19 minutes of play.

text: “We ran into a buzz saw,” suno kay Curry.
english: “We ran into a buzz saw,” according to Curry.

text: “We obviously know we are better than that.
english: “We obviously know we are better than that.

I’ve got to be better than that.”

“That was embarrassing,” pahayag pa sini.
english:
I’ve got to be better than that.”

“That was embarrassing,” he said.

english: The Grizzlies had a 57-point lead before the game ended with a 51-point gap in their scores.

text: Ini nga final margin kag point deficit amo ang pinakadaku nga na-rekord subong nga season.
english: This final margin and point deficit was the largest on record this season.

text: Ini ang ika-lima nga tion sa maragtas sang Warriors nga nalutos sila sa hampang sa regular season sa masobra 50 puntos.
english: It was the fifth time in Warriors history that they lost a regular season game by more than 50 points.

text: Sa sining lima, tatlo ang natabo sa sulod lamang sang lima ka tuig — 53 puntos sa Tampa, Florida sang 2021; 52 puntos sa Boston sang Marso 2024; kag 51 puntos sa Sacramento, California kahapon sang aga PHT.
english: Of these five, three occurred in just five years — 53 points in Tampa, Florida in 2021; 52 points in Boston in March 2024; and 51 points in Sacramento, California yesterday morning PHT.

text: Ini nga hampang amo man ang debut ni Dennis Schroder sa Warriors halin sang gin-trade ini sang Brooklyn Nets.
english: This game was also Dennis Schroder’s Warriors debut since being traded to the Brooklyn Nets.

text: Nagtapos siya nga may five points kag five assists.
english: He finished with five points and five assists.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, gina-selebrar naman sang Grizzlies (19-9) ang ila duha ka daku nga kadalag-an subong nga regular season.
english: Meanwhile, the Grizzlies (19-9) are celebrating their two big wins this regular season.

text: Magluwas nga ginpahuy-an ang Warriors (14-12), ginlutos man nila ang Portland Trail Blazers sang Nobyembre 10 paagi sa 45 puntos nga abanse.
english: In addition to humiliating the Warriors (14-12), they also defeated the Portland Trail Blazers on Nov. 10 by a 45-point lead.

text: Ipatuman na bwas ang oil price rollback.
english: The oil price rollback will be implemented tomorrow.

english: According to Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, after the oil price adjustment last week, the rollback in fuel prices will be implemented tomorrow, February 11.

text: Ang nutrisyon kag ehersisyo ang lunsay importante ilabi na sa pag pa-improve sang ikaayong lawas sang tawo.
english: Nutrition and exercise are both important especially in improving human health.

text: Apang may yara sang ika-tatlo nga factor nga makahatag sang overall wellness — ina amo ang pag-angkon sang bastante nga tulog.
english: But there’s a third factor that can contribute to overall wellness — that’s getting enough sleep.

text: Suno kay General Internal Medicine kag IFM Certified Medicine Practitioner Dr. Oyie Balburias, ang tulog, nutrisyon kag ehersisyo ang tatlo ka mga factors sa aton ikaayong lawas.
english: According to General Internal Medicine and IFM Certified Medicine Practitioner Dr. Oyie Balburias, sleep, nutrition and exercise are the three factors in our health.

text: Dapat nga mangin balanse ang tatlo ka mga factors agud nga mangin healthy pahayag sang doktor.
english: The three factors must be balanced in order to be healthy, the doctor said.

text: May yara man sang insakto nga oras sa pagtulog kag pagbugtaw suno kay Dr. Balburias — ina amo ang alas-9 sang gab-i tubtob alas 6 sa aga.
english: There is also a proper time to sleep and wake up, according to Dr. Balburias — that’s 9pm to 6am.

english: When a person sleeps late, the food they eat is not metabolized, which causes them to gain weight.

text: Nagahina man ang immune system sang tawo kun tatlo tubtob apat ka oras lang ang iya nga tulog bangud indi na makahimo pa sang nagkalain-lain nga immune cells ang lawas.
english: A person's immune system also weakens if he sleeps only three to four hours because the body can no longer produce various immune cells.
