text:
Gin-record sang 22-anyos nga aktres nga si Belle Mariano ang kanta nga “Anong Daratnan” nga amo ang special end credit song para sa Philippine release sang animated movie nga ‘Moana 2.’

Ginkumpirma ini sang Disney Studios Philippines kadungan sang pag-upload sang video kun sa diin nakit-an si Belle nga naga-promote sa kanta nga natalana nga i-release sa masunod nga semana.
english:
22-year-old actress Belle Mariano recorded the song “Anong Daratnan” which is the special end credit song for the Philippine release of the animated movie ‘Moana 2.’

This was confirmed by Disney Studios Philippines while uploading a video where Belle is seen promoting the song which is scheduled to be released next week.

text: “Hi everyone, Belle here!
english: “Hi everyone, Belle here!

text: And I can’t wait for you guys to hear ‘Anong Daratnan,’ a special end credit song for the Philippine movie release of Disney’s ‘Moana 2.’ Abangan niyo ang music video and single dropping next week.
english: And I can’t wait for you guys to hear ‘Anong Daratnan,’ a special end credit song for the Philippine movie release of Disney’s ‘Moana 2.’ Stay tuned for the music video and single dropping next week.

text: Disney’s ‘Moana 2’ arrives in cinemas November 27.
english: Disney’s ‘Moana 2’ arrives in theaters November 27.

text: Book your tickets now,” kabahin sang statement ni Belle.
english: Book your tickets now,” Belle said in a statement.

text: Ang “Anong Daratnan” amo ang Tagalog version sang “Beyond” halin sa second “Moana” film sang Disney.
english: “Anong Daratnan” is the Tagalog version of “Beyond” from Disney’s second “Moana” film.

text: Natalana nga ipaguwa ang “Moana 2” sa Philippine cinemas sa Nobyembre 27.
english: “Moana 2” is scheduled to be released in Philippine cinemas on November 27.

text: Magluwas sa sini nga project, balantayan man si Belle kag iya screen partner nga si Donny Pangilinan sa new original Viu series nga “How To Spot A Red Flag” nga magasugod sa streaming sa November 25.
english: Aside from this project, Belle and her screen partner Donny Pangilinan will also be seen in the new original Viu series “How To Spot A Red Flag” which will start streaming on November 25.

text: Nalapawan na ni Los Angeles Lakers superstar LeBron James ang record ni six-time NBA Most Valuable Player Kareem Abdul-Jabbar sa pinakamalawig nga minutos nga paghampang sa regular season history sa liga.
english: Los Angeles Lakers superstar LeBron James has surpassed six-time NBA Most Valuable Player Kareem Abdul-Jabbar’s record for the most minutes played in regular season history in the league.

text: Nalab-ot ni James ang pang-57,447 nga minuto kadungan sang paghampang kag pagdaog sang Lakers batok sa Sacramento Kings, Disyembre 20 PHT.
english: James reached the 57,447th minute in the Lakers' win over the Sacramento Kings on December 20 PHT.

text: Antes kay LeBron, ang naga-uyat sini nga record amo si Abdul-Jabbar nga isa man ka six-time NBA champion.
english: Before LeBron, the holder of this record was Abdul-Jabbar who is also a six-time NBA champion.

text: Nagtapos ini sa iya karera sang 1989 nga nakahampang sa sulod sang 57,446 minutes.
english: This ended his career in 1989 having played for 57,446 minutes.

text: Naguba ini nga record sa ika-dies nga minuto nga hampang sang Lakers batok sa Kings — nga amo man ang team nga kasumpong ni James kadungan sang iya NBA debut kaupod sa Cleveland Cavaliers sang 2003.
english: That record was broken in the 10th minute of the Lakers’ game against the Kings — which is also the team James faced off against in conjunction with his NBA debut with the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003.

text: Sa kabug-usan, 1,500 games na ang na-updan ni James sa iya bilog nga karera sa NBA.
english: In total, James has played in 1,500 games throughout his NBA career.

text: “It’s just a commitment to the craft and to the passion and love I have for the game.
english: “It’s just a commitment to the craft and to the passion and love I have for the game.

text: I don’t take much time in the off-season.
english: I don’t take much time in the off-season.

text: A little bit more time now,” pahayag sini matapos ang nakuha ang bag-o nga record.
english: A little bit more time now,” he said after the new record was obtained.

text: Subong nga Disyembre, maga-tungtong na ang Lakers superstar sa edad nga 40-anyos.
english: This December, the Lakers superstar will turn 40 years old.

text: Duha na ka games ang iya na-miss subong nga season.
english: He has already missed two games this season.

text:
“I didn’t take much time in the offseason, no matter if I was making the 10 Finals appearances back-to-back and just always trying to keep my body in tip-top shape.”

Ini na ang iya pang-22 nga NBA season.
english:
“I didn’t take much time in the offseason, no matter if I was making the 10 Finals appearances back-to-back and just always trying to keep my body in tip-top shape.”

This is his 22nd NBA season.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, nalapawan man ni LeBron si Abdul-Jabbar kag nangin all-time leading scorer nga subong may masobra na sa 41,000 points nga nahimo.
english: Last year, LeBron also surpassed Abdul-Jabbar to become the all-time leading scorer who now has more than 41,000 points scored.

text: Kadamo sang mga tawo nga gusto makahimo sang world record.
english: There are a lot of people who want to set a world record.

text: Daw sa ano bala nga ikaw gid ang pinakasagad, ukon ang ginakilala nga pinakamaayo, sa isa ka bagay?
english: What does it feel like to be the best, or recognized as the best, at something?

text: Sa Nigeria, pinasahi pa gid ang napinsaran sang isa ka lalaki agud maka-set sang record — ini amo ang sige-sige nga paghibi sa sulod sang 100 ka oras!
english: In Nigeria, a man came up with something even more unique to set a record — it was crying for 100 hours!

text: Ang lalaki amo si Tembu Daniel nga may bansag nga towncryer.
english: The man was Tembu Daniel with the nickname of towncryer.

text: Sang damlag lang, gin-umpisahan ni Tembu ang iya nga crying marathon apang ginsuspinde man niya makaligad ang anum ka oras bangud sa side effects.
english: Recently, Tembu started her crying marathon but suspended it after six hours due to side effects.

text: Suno kay Tembu, nakabatyag siya sang tuman ka sakit nga ulo, nagahabok ang iya mata pati ang iya nawong, kag ang pinaka-malala pa, temporaryo nga nadula ang iya panan-awan sa sulod sang 45 minutos.
english: According to Tembu, he felt a severe headache, his eyes and face were swollen, and worst of all, he temporarily lost his sight for 45 minutes.

text: Bangud sa partial nga pagkabulag, gin-islan niya ang iya nga estratehiya paagi sa paghibi samtang nagakaon kag pagpamati sa masubo nga background music.
english: Due to partial blindness, she changed her strategy by crying while eating and listening to sad background music.

text: Indi man maathag kun nalab-ot sini ang iya 100 ka oras nga target nga crying marathon.
english: It is also unclear whether she reached her 100-hour crying marathon target.

text: Ginpasa man sang nasambit nga African ‘town crier’ ang iya nga record attempt sa Guinness World Records.
english: The African town crier also submitted his record attempt to the Guinness World Records.

text: Nag-react naman ang Guinness kag nagsiling nga indi sila mag-monitor sa amo nga sahi nga attempt, kag may yara man sang gin-share nga guidelines kun ano dapat ang sundon kun maghimo sang world record.
english: Guinness reacted and said they would not monitor such an attempt, and also shared guidelines on what should be followed when making a world record.

text: Preparado kag naka-standby na ang mga security personnel sa pagbantay sa nagahilapit nga pista ni Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria nga amo ang patrona sang Western Visayas.
english: Security personnel are ready and on standby to guard the upcoming feast of Our Lady of the Candlemas, the patron saint of Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMAJ.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMAJ.

text: Shella Mae Sangrines, Spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa duha ka Police station sa distrito sang Jaro, maga-deploy man ang Iloilo City Police halin sa mobile patrol units, Iloilo City Mobile Force Company kag SWAT Personnel.
english: Shella Mae Sangrines, Spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Station, said that besides the two police stations in Jaro district, the Iloilo City Police will also deploy from mobile patrol units, Iloilo City Mobile Force Company and SWAT Personnel.

text: Suno man sa iya, hugot man nga pagabantayan ang Jaro Plaza bangud sa masami nga nagakalatabo diri sa mga dalagko nga mga aktibidad.
english: He said the Jaro Plaza will also be closely monitored due to the frequent incidents of large-scale activities.

text: Nagalaum man ini nga magabuligay ang mga Ilonggo sa pagselebrar sang pista agud nga liwat nga mag zero incident ang siudad kaangay sang Dinagyang Festival 2026.
english: He also hopes that Ilonggos will work together to celebrate the festival so that the city will again have zero incidents like the Dinagyang Festival 2026.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo radio kay PMaj.
english: In an interview with Bombo radio, PMaj.

text: Eduardo Siacon Jr., Officer-in-charge sang Iloilo City Police Station 9, iya ginpahayag nga magabutang sila sang apat ka mga screening areas sa palibot sang Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral agud nga indi makasulod ang mga deadly weapons, vape, sigarilyo, kag mga makahulubog nga mga ilimnon.
english: Eduardo Siacon Jr., Officer-in-charge of Iloilo City Police Station 9, said they will set up four screening areas around the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral to prevent the entry of deadly weapons, vape, cigarettes, and alcoholic beverages.

text: Nagpahayag man ini sa mga may plano nga mag inom-inom sa kapistahan nga mangin responsable sa ila pag-inom agud nga malikawan ang kun ano man nga ginamo.
english: He also urged those who plan to drink during the festival to be responsible in their drinking to avoid any trouble.

text: Liwat nga nagpaandam si US President Donald Trump nga daku nga kunsekwensya ang atubangon sang Russia pananglitan indi magsugot si Russian leader Vladimir Putin sa ceasefire.
english: US President Donald Trump has once again warned that Russia will face serious consequences if Russian leader Vladimir Putin does not agree to a ceasefire.

text: Ginbuy-an ni Trump ini nga paandam antes ang ila meeting ni Putin sa Alaska sa Byernes agud istoryahan ang ginaproponer nga kasugtanan agud mauntat ang gyera sa Ukraine.
english: Trump unleashed this warning ahead of his meeting with Putin in Alaska on Friday to discuss a proposed deal to end the war in Ukraine.

text: “I don’t have to say.
english: “I don’t have to say.

text:
There will be very severe consequences,” sabat ni Trump kun taripa ukon sanctions ang buot-silingon niya sa “kunsekwensya.”

Antes sini nga meeting, nagtawag man si Trump sa mga lider sa Europa lakip na kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
english:
There will be very severe consequences,” Trump replied if he meant tariffs or sanctions by “consequences.”

Ahead of this meeting, Trump also called European leaders including Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

text: Suno kay Zelensky, ginpasalig sang American leader nga handa ang US nga padayunon ang suporta sini sa Kyiv.
english: According to Zelensky, the American leader assured that the US is ready to continue its support to Kyiv.

text: Ginpahayag nga lakip sa meeting sang “coalition of the willing” amo ang Germany, France kag United Kingdom.
english: The meeting of the “coalition of the willing” reportedly included Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

text: Apisar wala pa natabo ang Trump-Putin meeting, nagaguwa man subong ang mga inisyal nga impormasyon nga posible magakitaay liwat ang duha ka mga lider kag updon na si Zelensky.
english: Although the Trump-Putin meeting has not yet taken place, initial information is emerging that the two leaders may meet again and accompany Zelensky.

text: Samtang naga-amat-amat na sako ang gift shopping para sa Valentine’s Day, nagpaandam ang toxics watchdog nga EcoWaste Coalition batok sa pagbakal sang perfumes nga nagaunod sang ginadumilian nga toxic chemicals.
english: As gift shopping for Valentine's Day gets busier, the toxics watchdog EcoWaste Coalition has warned against buying perfumes containing banned toxic chemicals.

text: Kasunod ini sang market surveillance sang grupo kun sa diin ginpahayag nga may nakit-an sila nga 35 perfume products halin sa 16 brand nga may yara sang ingredient nga butylphenyl methylpropional (BMHCA) ukon kilala man nga lilial ukon lysmeral.
english: This follows the group's market surveillance where they said they found 35 perfume products from 16 brands that contain the ingredient butylphenyl methylpropional (BMHCA) or also known as lilial or lysmeral.

text: Suno sa watchdog, ang pagbaligya sini nga produkto ang nagalapas sa Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Circular No.
english: According to the watchdog, the sale of this product violates Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Circular No.

text: 2023-007 nga amo ang naga-ban sa amo nga chemical sa cosmetics.
english: 2023-007 which bans such chemical in cosmetics.

text: Delikado ini suno sa grupo bangud mahalitan sini ang reproductive process ilabi na ang lapsag nga yara sa taguangkan sang isa ka iloy.
english: The group said it is dangerous because it can damage the reproductive process especially the baby in the womb of a mother.

text: Magluwas sa reproductive toxicity, makatuga man ini sang endocrine disruption kag allergic reactions.
english: In addition to reproductive toxicity, it can also cause endocrine disruption and allergic reactions.

text: Base pa sa EcoWaste Coalition, sa ila test buys, natukiban nga ang banned perfumes ang ginabaligya sa balor nga P75 to P300 sa major shopping hubs sa Makati, Manila, kag Quezon City.
english: According to the EcoWaste Coalition, in their test buys, it was found that the banned perfumes are sold for P75 to P300 in major shopping hubs in Makati, Manila, and Quezon City.

text: Ini nga mga produkto ang ginabug-usan sang eau de parfum, eau de toilette, fragrance lotion, fragrance mist, kag body mist kag nagaguwa nga mga imitation items lamang.
english: These products consist of eau de parfum, eau de toilette, fragrance lotion, fragrance mist, and body mist and appear to be imitation items only.

text: Gin-report na ang findings sa FDA kag nagpanawagan man sa otoridad nga maghulag na batok sa importers, distributors, kag retailers sini nga banned products.
english: The findings have been reported to the FDA and called on the authorities to take action against importers, distributors, and retailers of these banned products.

text: Nabuhinan sang isa pa gid ka kandidata ang Miss Universe competition apisar nga nagahinampot na ang koronasyon.
english: The Miss Universe competition has been reduced to one more contestant despite the fact that the coronation is approaching.

text: Ginkumpirma sang Miss South Africa Organization nga nag-atras ang ila kandidata nga si Mia Le Roux bangud sa problema sini sa ikaayong-lawas.
english: The Miss South Africa Organization has confirmed that its contestant Mia Le Roux has withdrawn due to health problems.

text: Sa official statement, ginpaathag sini nga indi mahapos para sa iya ang pag-withdraw apang nagapasalamat siya sa oportunidad nga makatutok sa iya recovery para maserbehan sini liwat sang bug-os kusog ang iya pungsod.
english: In an official statement, he explained that it was not easy for him to withdraw but he is grateful for the opportunity to focus on his recovery so that he can serve his country again with full strength.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang beauty queen sa iya supporters sa South Africa.
english: The beauty queen also thanked her supporters in South Africa.

text: “Making this decision has been incredibly challenging, knowing the dreams and hopes that have been placed upon me.
english: “Making this decision has been incredibly challenging, knowing the dreams and hopes that have been placed upon me.

text: However, I am deeply grateful to have the opportunity to focus on my health and recovery so that I may continue to serve my country with full strength,” kabahin sang statement sini.
english: However, I am deeply grateful to have the opportunity to focus on my health and recovery so that I may continue to serve my country with full strength,” his statement said.

text: Ginklaro naman sang Miss South Africa Organization nga suportado nila ang desisyon ni Mia kag ang iya health kag well-being amo gid ang nagapanguna nga prayoridad.
english: The Miss South Africa Organization has made it clear that they support Mia's decision and that her health and well-being are the top priority.

text: “[W]e stand by her side, dedicated to ensuring she regains her strength and returns to full health.
english: “[W]e stand by her side, dedicated to ensuring she regains her strength and returns to full health.

text: Our hearts are with her as she takes the necessary steps toward recovery,” suno sa organisasyon.
english: Our hearts are with her as she takes the necessary steps toward recovery,” according to the organization.

text: Antes kay Mia, nag-withdraw man si Italy Mora sang Panama apang ginklaro sang Miss Universe organization nga ini nga desisyon ang kasunod sang evaluation sang ila nga disciplinary commission.
english: Before Mia, Italy Mora of Panama also withdrew but the Miss Universe organization clarified that this decision followed the evaluation of their disciplinary commission.

text: Biyernes, Nobyembre 15, sang ginpatigayon ang preliminary competition sa Mexico City kun sa diin ang previous winners nga sanday R’Bonney Gabriel sang USA kag Sheynnis Palacos sang Nicaragua ang nagserbe nga hosts.
english: The preliminary competition was held on Friday, November 15, in Mexico City where previous winners R'Bonney Gabriel of the USA and Sheynnis Palacos of Nicaragua served as hosts.

text: Domingo sang aga (Philippine time) ang koronasyon kun sa diin tinguhaan ni Chelsea Manalo nga makuha ang panglima nga Miss Universe crown para sa Pilipinas.#
english: The coronation will be held on Sunday morning (Philippine time) where Chelsea Manalo will try to win the fifth Miss Universe crown for the Philippines.

text: USA – Normal lamang nga makabatyag sang stress bangud sa trabaho ukon sa pagpangabuhi kag kun indi maagapan, sa ulihi, mahimo ini nga magresulta sa heart attack.
english: USA – It is normal to feel stressed because of work or life and if not treated, it can eventually result in a heart attack.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala nga ang mga babayi ang mas prone sa pagbatyag sang stress kun ipaanggid sa mga lalaki?
english: But did you know that women are more prone to feeling stressed compared to men?

text: Suno kay Xiao Xu, assistant professor sa obstetrics, gynecology and reproductive sciences sa Yale University sa New Haven, Connecticut sa Estados Unidos, ang mga young women ang madali nga makabatyag sang stress kag may yara sang worse recovery kun ipaanggid sa mga young men.
english: According to Xiao Xu, assistant professor of obstetrics, gynecology and reproductive sciences at Yale University in New Haven, Connecticut in the United States, young women are more likely to feel stress and have worse recovery compared to young men.

text: Ginpahayag ni Xu nga santo sa pag-tuon kun sa diin siya ang co-author, mas mataas ang mortality rate sang mga babayi kun stress ang pagahambalan kag ini ang mahimo nga tuga sang family conflict, bisyo, unhealthy lifestyle, balatian ukon kamatayon sang pinalangga sa kabuhi.
english: Xu said that according to a study in which she is a co-author, women have a higher mortality rate when it comes to stress and this can be caused by family conflict, addiction, unhealthy lifestyle, illness or death of a loved one.

text: Isa man sa mga rason kun nga-a mas stress ang mga babayi amo nga kun paano nila mahatag ang familiy care apisar sang lower financial resources ukon kapigaduhon.
english: One of the reasons why women are more stressed is how they can provide family care despite lower financial resources or poverty.

text: Sa pagpaathag naman ni Dr. Suzanne V. Arnold, research assistant professor sa University of Missouri sa Kansas City sa Estados Unidos, ang mga tawo nga may madamo nga isyu ukon concern sa health kag personal life ang may mataas nga risgo sa pagbatyag sang stress.
english: In the explanation of Dr. Suzanne V. Arnold, research assistant professor at the University of Missouri in Kansas City in the United States, people who have many issues or concerns in health and personal life are at high risk of feeling stress.

text: Agud nga malikawan ang pag-angkon sang heart attack ukon ano man nga sahi sang balati-an tuga sang stress, mas importante suno kay Arnold nga mahatagan sang solusyon sa labing madali nga tion ang nagkalain-lain nga level sang stress santo sa psychosocial needs sang pasyente.
english: In order to avoid heart attack or any other kind of stress-related illness, Arnold said it is more important to provide solutions as soon as possible to the different levels of stress based on the psychosocial needs of the patient.

issue), nasugid naton nga may mga tanom nga makatabog sang mga insekto agud

I will first name here two

text:

english:
Lemongrass is also even a popular
kitchen utensils to flavor dishes such as chicken stew and
boiled meat, and even as a filling for roasted pork.

text:
“Luas nga isa ka importante nga herb ang
tanglad, makabulig man ini sa pagtabog palayo sang dengue mosquitoes,” pamatuod

Coordinator for Metro Manila sa Ovicidal/Larvicidal (OL) Mosquito Trap

english:

text: Nagapang-agda gid ang Archdiocese of Jaro sa tanan nga mga deboto nga magpakigbahin sa nagahilapit nga kapiyestahan ni Nuestra Señora dela Candelaria, ang patrona sang Western Visayas, sa Pebrero 2.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro cordially invites all devotees to participate in the upcoming feast of Nuestra Señora dela Candelaria, the patron saint of Western Visayas, on February 2.

text: May kaangtanan diri, ginpagwa na man sang Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral ang schedule sang mga misa sa National Shrine of Our Lady of Candles sa Jaro.
english: In this regard, the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral has also released the schedule of masses at the National Shrine of Our Lady of Candles in Jaro.

text: Sa Pebrero 1 nga bisperas sang piyesta, may Solemn Vesperal Mass sa las-5 sa hapon nga pangunahan ni His Grace, Most Rev.
english: On February 1, the eve of the feast, there will be a Solemn Vesperal Mass at 5 pm led by His Grace, Most Rev.

text: Jose Romeo O. Lazo sang Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro.
english: Jose Romeo O. Lazo of the Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro.

text: Ini ang pagasundan sang Rite of Coronation of the Image sa Cathedral’s Balcony nga pangunahan naman ni His Grace Most Rev.
english: This will be followed by the Rite of Coronation of the Image at the Cathedral’s Balcony presided over by His Grace Most Rev.

text: Midyphil B. Billones.
english: Midyphil B. Billones.

text: Sa adlaw mismo sang kapiestahan sa Pebrero 2,las-siete sa aga, may hiwaton nga Solemn Pontifical Mass kaupod ang Blessing of Candles kag pangunahan sa gihapon ni Archbishop Billones.
english: On the day of the feast itself on February 2, at 7 am, there will be a Solemn Pontifical Mass with the Blessing of Candles and will be presided over by Archbishop Billones.

text: Hiwaton naman las 5:30 sa hapon pagkatapos sang Solemn Procession, ang Solemn Concelebrated Mass nga pangunahan ni His Excellency Most Rev.
english: The Solemn Concelebrated Mass will be held at 5:30 pm after the Solemn Procession.

english: Ruben Labajo, Bishop of the Diocese of Prosperidad in Agusan del Sur.

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rev.
english:
This year’s theme is “Nuestra Señora dela Candelaria: Bearing the Light for Deeper Faith and Obedience Towards Accountable Stewardship.”

In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rev.

text: Angelo Colada, director sang Commission on Social Communications sang Archdiocese of Jaro, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong nga tuig, wala sang pagbag-o sa dalagan sang selebrasyon.
english: Angelo Colada, director of the Commission on Social Communications of the Archdiocese of Jaro, said that this year, there is no change in the course of the celebration.

text: Suno kay Colada, magapabilin gihapon nga sentro sang kapistahan ang pagpadalom pa gid sang pagtuo kag debosyon.
english: According to Colada, the focus of the festivities will remain on deepening faith and devotion.

text: Gindugang man ni Colada nga available na ang perdon candles sa Libreria Candelaria, Jaro Cathedral kag iban nga affiliated retailers.
english: Colada added that the perdon candles are now available at Libreria Candelaria, Jaro Cathedral and other affiliated retailers.

text: Nagpangabay naman si Colada nga indi paghingalitan ang kapiestahan nga magpamentaha sa pagbaligya sang perdon candles nga ang presyo ang yara lang sa P40 kada isa.
english: Colada urged the public not to disrupt the festivities by selling pardon candles at P40 each.

text: Ang mga napatay amo ang duha ka mga correspondent lakip na diri ang isa isa ka rominente nga reporter, sang Al Jazeera kag tatlo ka mga cameraman.
english: The dead were two correspondents including a rominent reporter, of Al Jazeera and three cameramen.

text: Suno sa Qatar-based broadcaster, lakip sa napatay amo ang isa ka kilala nga correspondent nga si Anas al-Sharif, 28-anyos kag ini ang naga-report sa northern Gaza.
english: According to the Qatar-based broadcaster, among the dead was a well-known correspondent Anas al-Sharif, 28, who reported in northern Gaza.

text: Si Al-Sharif ang isa na sa mga target sang mga Israeli military bangud sa ginaalegar nga may kaangtanan ini sa terorista sa Hamas.
english: Al-Sharif has been targeted by the Israeli military for alleged links to terrorists in Hamas.

text: Ginpahayag sang Israel nga isa siya sa nagaserbe nga leader sang mga terrorist cell sa Hamas terrorist organization kag responsible sa rocket attacks batok sa Israeli civilians kag IDF troops.
english: Israel said he was one of the serving leaders of terrorist cells in the Hamas terrorist organization and responsible for rocket attacks against Israeli civilians and IDF troops.

text: Sa subong naglab-ot sa ginabulubanta 200 ka mga media workers ang napatay sa nasambit nga gyera sa sulod sang 22 ka bulan na nga padayon nga gyera, ini suno sa data sang media watchdogs.
english: So far, an estimated 200 media workers have been killed in the war during the 22-month-old war, according to data from media watchdogs.

text: Ginkoronahan nga bag-o nga Miss International ang tiglawas sang Vietnam sa coronation night nga ginpatigayon sa Japan.
english: Vietnam's representative was crowned the new Miss International at the coronation night held in Japan.

text: Ini amo si Huỳnh Thị Thanh Thủy nga nangibabaw gikan sa 70 ka mga kandidata.
english: It was Huỳnh Thị Thanh Thủy who emerged out of 70 candidates.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga korona sang Vietnam sa maragtas sang Miss International.
english: It is the first ever Vietnamese crown in the history of Miss International.

text: 1st Runner-Up naman si Miss Bolivia, 2nd Runner-Up si Miss Spain, 3rd Runner-Up si Miss Venezuela, kag 4th Runner-Up si Miss Indonesia.
english: Miss Bolivia was 1st Runner-Up, Miss Spain was 2nd Runner-Up, Miss Venezuela was 3rd Runner-Up, and Miss Indonesia was 4th Runner-Up.

text: Samtang, napaslawan naman nga makasulod sa top 20 ang pambato sang Pilipinas nga si Angelica Lopez.
english: Meanwhile, Philippine singer Angelica Lopez failed to make the top 20.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagapasalamat gihapon si Lopez nga ginsaligan kag ginsuportahan siya sang mga Pinoy agud itiglawas ang Pilipinas.
english: Meanwhile, Lopez is still grateful that the Filipinos trusted and supported him to represent the Philippines.

text: Magakadto na sa Golden State Warriors ang point guard sang Brooklyn Nets nga si Dennis Schroder.
english: Brooklyn Nets point guard Dennis Schroder is headed to the Golden State Warriors.

text: Bilang kabaylo, ipadala naman sang Warriors sa Nets ang ila injured guard nga si De’Anthony Melton kag tatlo ka second-round picks.
english: In exchange, the Warriors will send the Nets their injured guard De’Anthony Melton and three second-round picks.

text: Magluwas kay Schroder nga isa man ka 2023 World Cup champion, makabaton man ang Golden State sang 2025 second-round draft pick (via Miami).
english: In addition to Schroder also being a 2023 World Cup champion, Golden State will also receive a 2025 second-round draft pick (via Miami).

text: Nahibaluan nga may average ang 31-anyos nga si Schroder nga 18.4 points kag may career-best nga 6.6 assists sa 23 ka hampang sini sa Nets subong nga season nga pang-10 sa Eastern Conference.
english: The 31-year-old Schroder averaged 18.4 points and a career-best 6.6 assists in 23 games with the Nets this season, 10th in the Eastern Conference.

text: Ini na ang iya pang-12 nga NBA season kag mangin ikawalo sini nga team ang Warriors matapos ang iya stints sa Atlanta Hawks, Oklahoma City Thunder, Los Angeles Lakers, Boston Celtics, Toronto Raptors, kag Houston Rockets.
english: This will be his 12th NBA season and the Warriors will be his eighth team after stints with the Atlanta Hawks, Oklahoma City Thunder, Los Angeles Lakers, Boston Celtics, Toronto Raptors, and Houston Rockets.

text: Ginalauman nga ma-finalize ini nga trade subong nga adlaw kun tugutan na sang National Basketball Association (NBA) ang paghulag sang mga team.
english: The trade is expected to be finalized today when the National Basketball Association (NBA) allows the teams to move.

text: Kun maplantsa na ang agreement, mahatagan ang Warriors sang isa pa ka shooter nga mahimo makaupod kay Stephen Curry.
english: Once the agreement is ironed out, the Warriors will be given another shooter who can join Stephen Curry.

text: Pang-lima ang Golden State sa Western Conference nga may 14-10 record.
english: Golden State is fifth in the Western Conference with a 14-10 record.

text: Sinunog ng isang pamangkin ang bahay ng kanyang tiyuhin sa Barangay Dorog, Leon, Iloilo pasado alas-8:10 ng gabi, Oktubre 28, matapos hindi siya pahiramin ng motorsiklo nito.
english: A nephew set fire to his uncle's house in Barangay Dorog, Leon, Iloilo around 8:10 pm, October 28, after he refused to lend him a motorcycle.

text: Kinilala ang suspek bilang si alyas Toto, 26 taong gulang.
english: The suspect was identified as alias Toto, 26 years old.

text: Ayon kay Police Captain Martin Pugales, officer-in-charge ng Leon Municipal Police Station, nagalit umano ang suspek matapos tanggihan ng kanyang tiyuhin na gamitin ang motorsiklo.
english: According to Police Captain Martin Pugales, officer-in-charge of the Leon Municipal Police Station, the suspect allegedly became angry after his uncle refused to use the motorcycle.

text: Pinaniniwalaang nasa ilalim ng impluwensiya ng alak ang suspek nang umakyat ito sa ikalawang palapag ng bahay at sinilaban ang foam, na naging sanhi ng mabilis na pagkalat ng apoy dahil gawa sa light materials ang nasabing bahagi ng bahay.
english: It is believed that the suspect was under the influence of alcohol when he climbed to the second floor of the house and lit the foam, which caused the fire to spread quickly because the said part of the house was made of light materials.

text: Dalawa pang bahay ang nadamay bago tuluyang naapula ang apoy.
english: Two other houses were damaged before the fire was completely extinguished.

text: Idineklara ng mga awtoridad na totally damaged ang bahay ng tiyuhin, habang bahagyang nasira naman ang bahay ng suspek.
english: Authorities declared that the house of the uncle was totally damaged, while the house of the suspect was partially damaged.

text: Wala namang naiulat na nasugatan sa insidente.
english: No injuries were reported in the incident.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, nasa kustodiya na ng Leon Municipal Police Station ang suspek at posibleng sampahan ng kasong arson.
english: The suspect is currently in the custody of the Leon Municipal Police Station and may be charged with arson.

english: (with reports from Bombo Ronalyn Salvadico)

text: Gin-ako ni Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga masakit para sa iya nga makit-an sa presuhan ang iya abyan nga si former Senator Bong Revilla.
english: Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla admitted that it is painful for him to see his friend former Senator Bong Revilla in jail.

text: Kasunod ini sang pagbutang kay Revilla sa Quezon City Jail bangud sa indi mapyansahan nga kaso nga malversation nga naangot sa ginaalegar nga ghost flood control project sa Bulacan.
english: This follows Revilla's placement in the Quezon City Jail for non-bailable malversation charges related to the alleged ghost flood control project in Bulacan.

text: Suno kay Remulla, apisar pa sang ila nga pag-abyanay, mas pasulabihon gihapon sini ang iya trabaho para sa interes sang pungsod.
english: According to Remulla, despite their friendship, he will still prioritize his work for the interest of the country.

text: “Sabi ko naman, this is my last gesture of friendship to you.
english: “I said, this is my last gesture of friendship to you.

text: Dadalhin ka dito habang hindi ka pa arraigned.
english: You will be brought here while you are not arraigned.

text: Pag-serve ng warrant, nag-surrender siya, sabi ko ako na maghahatid sayo, as far as it goes, ‘yun na ‘yung huling pag-uusap namin,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: When the warrant was served, he surrendered, I said I'll take you, as far as it goes, that's the last time we talked,” the secretary said.

text: “It pains me to see a friend go to jail.
english: “It pains me to see a friend go to jail.

text: But my commitment to country goes beyond the friendship in this country.
english: But my commitment to country goes beyond the friendship in this country.

text: Uunahin ko muna ang bansa kahit ano mangyari,” dugang pa sini.
english: I will put the country first no matter what,” he added.

text: Ginpaanggid man niya ini sa iya nga relasyon kay former House Speaker kag subong Leyte Rep.
english: He also compared it to his relationship with former House Speaker and current Leyte Rep.

text: Martin Romualdez.
english: Martin Romualdez.

text: Na-implicate man si Romualdez sa flood control corruption, apang wala pa ini opisyal nga napasakaan sang kaso kaangot sa amo nga eskandalo.
english: Romualdez has also been implicated in flood control corruption, but has not yet been officially charged in connection with the scandal.

text: “Pareho na rin yan kay Speaker Martin Romaldez.
english: “It’s the same with Speaker Martin Romaldez.

text: He was very close to me in college, fraternity brothers kami.
english: He was very close to me in college, we were fraternity brothers.

text: Pero uunahin natin lagi ang bansa,” suno kay Remulla.
english: But we will always put the country first,” Remulla said.

text: Updanay sila anay ni Romualdez sa Upsilon Sigma Phi sa University of the Philippines.
english: He and Romualdez were former roommates in Upsilon Sigma Phi at the University of the Philippines.

text: Kahapon, Enero 22, sang gin-release man sang DILG ang mga laragway ni Revilla kag sang anum ka iban pa nga akusado, apang naka-blur ang ila nga mga itsura antes ini ginpadala sa media.
english: Yesterday, January 22, when the DILG also released the pictures of Revilla and six other accused, but their faces were blurred before they were sent to the media.

english: Revilla is currently undergoing a one-week quarantine to ensure that he is free of infectious diseases before being joined by other persons deprived of liberty (PDL) in the cell.

english: Earlier, the DILG and BJMP assured that they will not give any special or VIP treatment to Revilla despite his high position in the past.

Malakanyang's position is that

Senator Panfilo Lacson lamented this, and
said that the Philippines will be defended on this issue, as
complainant, China has become Malakanyang's “defense counsel”.

text:
Nagtubong man sa sini nga pagpakamalaut ang
mga kritiko sang administrasyon nga ginapangunahan ni Vice President Leni
Robredo, kag sang madamo nga experts sa international law, lakip na dira si
Supreme Court Senior Justice Antonio Carpio kag si retired Ombudsman Conchita
Carpio-Morales.
english:
From this curse also grew the
critics of the administration led by Vice President Leni
Robredo, and many experts in international law, including
Supreme Court Senior Justice Antonio Carpio and retired Ombudsman Conchita
Carpio-Morales.

text:
Siling pa gani sang isa ka spokesman ni Vice
President Robredo nga ang sobra nga pagpaayon kag pagpangapin sang Malakanyang
sa Tsina isa ka “act of cowardice”, ukon panalaw nga wala sing basehan.
english:
A spokesman for Vice even said
President Robredo said Malakanyang's excessive appeasement and defense
in China an “act of cowardice”, or unfounded prejudice.

text:
Wala kita sing dapat kulbaan sa pamahog ukon
pagsalakay sang Tsina tungod sa Mutual Defense Treaty naton sa Estados Unidos,
siling gani ni Lacson.
english:
We have nothing to fear from threat or
Chinese attack because of our Mutual Defense Treaty with the United States,
Lacson said.
